articleTitle: Network Fault Prediction Based on CNN-LSTM Hybrid Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The network brings convenience and efficiency to people's life and work, and at the same time, the network will also cause loss to human beings because of failures, so it is particularly important to predict faults before the faults occur. The fault prediction technology can prepare the staff to repair the faults in advance, reduce the repair time of the fault, and thus reduce the loss caused by the faults. Therefore, this paper proposes a network log-based CNN-LSTM hybrid prediction model for wireless network faults: firstly, the network log is preprocessed, the sample is extracted by two-level time window, then the sample features are extracted by CNN, and finally, the extracted features are input into LSTM for prediction. To demonstrate the superiority of the CNN-LSTM hybrid neural network prediction model, in this experiment, it is compared with CNN and Random Forest. The result shows that the prediction performance of CNN-LSTM is better than the other two models.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the continuous development of computer network technology, security problems in the network are emerging one after another, and it is becoming more and more difficult to ignore. For the current network administrators, how to successfully prevent malicious network hackers from invading, so that network systems and computers are at Safe and normal operation is an urgent task. This paper proposes a network intrusion detection method based on deep learning. This method uses deep confidence neural network to extract features of network monitoring data, and uses BP neural network as top level classifier to classify intrusion types. The method was validated using the KDD CUP'99 dataset from the Lincoln Laboratory of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. The results show that the proposed method has a significant improvement over the traditional machine learning accuracy.

articleTitle: Moving Target Detection Using the 2D-FFT Algorithm for Automotive FMCW Radars
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The FMCW (frequency modulated continuous wave) automotive radar has been widely used in the advanced driving assistant system of vehicles. The basic idea of FMCW automotive radar is to obtain the range and velocity information from the beat signal. However, the information extracted from one frequency ramp will suffer from the range-velocity ambiguity problem. In this paper, several subsequent ramps have been generated to eliminate this ambiguity and a two dimensional FFT algorithm for the FMCW radar is presented. The parameters of FMCW signal are derived mathematically. An experiment in actual traffic environment is conducted and the offline raw radar data are captured by using the AWR1642BOOST. The data processed by MATLAB shows that the 2D FFT algorithm can obtain the range and velocity information of moving targets without ambiguity.

articleTitle: Research on Intrusion Detection Based on Improved DBN-ELM
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To leverage the feature extraction of DBN and the fast classification and good generalization of ELM, an improved method of DBN-ELM is proposed for intrusion detection. The improved model uses deep belief network (DBN) to train NSL-KDD dataset and feed them back to the extreme learning machine (ELM) for classification. A classifier is connected at each intermediate level of the DBN-ELM. By majority voting on the output of classifier and ELM, the final output is calculated by integration. Experiments show that the improved model increases the classification confidence and accuracy of the classifier. The model has been benchmarked on the NSL-KDD dataset, and the accuracy of the model has been improved to 97.82%, while the false alarm rate has been reduced to 1.81%. Proposed improved model has been also compared with DBN, ELM, DBN-ELM and achieves competitive accuracy.

articleTitle: EEG Signal Classification Method Based on Feature Priority Analysis and CNN
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In recent years, with the advancement of technology, more and more people with disabilities use prosthetic limbs to compensate for the function of normal upper limbs, so the demand for the upper limb movement recognition has increased. In addition, with the development of brain-computer interfaces, a large number of academic institutions are dedicated to identifying the upper limb movements through EEG signals. In this paper, a new EEG signal classification method is proposed to identify the upper limb movements. Firstly, the importance of EEG detection electrodes is sorted by random forest algorithm, and the higher priority electrodes are screened out. Then the wavelet transform method is used to extract the features of the original data that have been screened out. After that, the EEG signals are classified according to the extracted features by using convolutional neural network. The model designed in this paper has a classification accuracy rate of 93.22% on the WAY-EEG-GAL dataset, which is an effective EEG signal classification model.

articleTitle: Fog Node Selection for Low Latency Communication and Anomaly Detection in Fog Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The application of 5G in IOT (Internet of things) puts forward strict requirements for network latency. In view of the fog network scenario with large-scale IOT devices, this paper proposes a procedure of unsupervised learning to efficiently realize the requirement of low-latency communication. We propose an integrated K-means clustering and PCA fog computing design, which facilitates a new service of fog, anomaly detection. Computer simulation shows that, in the presence of large-scale path loss, shadow and small-scale fading channel, the system design with low latency needs to consider the deployment of dense fog nodes and adopt more frequency or power resources at the same time. The proposed procedure and machine learning design not only facilitates the selection of fog nodes, but also presents a new example of anomaly detection using fog nodes.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Intrusion Detection Method Based on Improved Fuzzy C-Means and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Currently, Intrusion Detection System (IDS) is an essential component of network security, which can detect abnormal access data or attacks. Misuse detection or anomaly detection is generally adopted in most of the existing IDS, while there are some disadvantages such as low detection rate and high false alarm rate. In this paper, a hybrid intrusion detection method based on improved Fuzzy C-Means (FCM) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) has been proposed. In the new method, FCM incorporating information gain ratio is firstly used to cluster the pre-processed training dataset, then SVM is used to classify them. The NSL-KDD dataset is used to verify the feasibility of the method. Accuracy, detection rate, and false alarm rate are indicators to evaluate its performance. The experimental results demonstrate that compared with other intrusion detection methods, the proposed method can detect intrusion attacks more effectively and decrease the false alarm rate.

articleTitle: An Access Control Model and Its Application in Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Access control technology is an important information security mechanism. At present, most of the database systems and enterprise information systems are role-based access control technologies, this rights management system has been running stably. However, due to the simple role access control, its flexibility and control granularity sometimes can't meet the requirements of actual access control. This paper proposes a secure access control model ARBACV1 based on RBACV1 combined with ABAC model, which is more flexible than RBACV1 and can perform fine-grained access control. The open transparency of data in the blockchain has caused people's high attention to data privacy protection issues[1]. A complete access control mechanism has not been provided in the Ethereum blockchain. To this end, according to the blockchain architecture, the proposed access control model ARBACV1 is applied to the blockchain through smart contracts, and the access of the blockchain users is controlled securely, and the code is written in Solidity language in Ethereum[2]. ARBACV1-based access control is implemented in blockchain.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Weibo Comments Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of network information technology, social media has become a new information dissemination platform, and has the characteristics of rapid dissemination and wide audience. This paper proposes a micro-blog commentary sentiment analysis method based on deep neural network. By constructing multi-level pooling layer and convolution layer, the network complexity is increased, and then the data features can be effectively extracted, the sentiment analysis accuracy rate can be improved, and the network can be avoided. Locally optimal. Firstly, the microblog commentary is preprocessed, then the word2vec algorithm is used for text representation, and the feature matrix is input into the convolutional neural network to extract the key features in the text. Finally, the softmax logistic regression network is used to classify the features and obtain the sentiment analysis results. Through experimental verification, the accuracy of this method is significantly improved compared with the traditional machine learning method.

articleTitle: A Geofence Algorithm for Autonomous Flight Unmanned Aircraft System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the safety of UAS flight, an autonomous flight UAS geofence algorithm is proposed. Firstly, by scaling the original geofence, a geofence pre-control-layer generation algorithm is proposed. Then, the buffer is added on the basis of traditional ray method to solve the problem of misjudgement of intersection points. The improved ray casting algorithm is used to detect the violation of geofence, and a re-planning method of the violating waypoints is proposed for the UAS with violating danger. The corresponding control law of boundary maintaining autonomous controls is designed. Simulation results both show that the UAS can modify the original flight path as little as possible on the basis of avoiding the violation of the geofence, and the proposed geofence algorithm is effective and can ensure the flight safety of autonomous UAS in geo-fence.

articleTitle: Decentralized Group Signature Scheme Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The group signature scheme is widely used in military and financial fields due to its efficient anonymity and revocability. However, in an untrusted environment, previous group signature schemes often suffer joint attacks from management centers or revocation centers, which reduces the security of the scheme. At the same time, the malicious group center and the signature recipient can identify the signer identity and also threaten the anonymity of the program. It is proved by calculation that the scheme can maintain the security and anonymity of the group signature algorithm in an untrusted environment.

articleTitle: The Development Trend Analysis of 5G Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the burgeoning of the Internet of everything, 5G network gradually attracts people's attention. Knowledge mapping is a novel analysis tool that combines theories and methods from mathematics, graphics, and other disciplines. However, to date, a knowledge mapping analysis of 5G network has not been performed. In this paper, we aim to analyze the development trend of 5G network by constructing knowledge mapping. We used Citespace and VOSviewer to analyze more than 3,000 papers downloaded from Web of Science(WoS), including paper distribution analysis, co-citation analysis, keyword analysis and hotspot analysis.

articleTitle: The Penetration Testing Framework for Large-Scale Network Based on Network Fingerprint
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: For a long time, the penetration testing techniques for large-scale network have been used by lawless elements to serve the Internet black industry chain. With the emergence and development of network fingerprinting technology and cyberspace search engine in recent years, large-scale network penetration test is expected to become one of the important methods to protect network security, playing an important role in quickly discovering and warning major security threats. This paper first introduces the principle and process of traditional penetration testing technology for large-scale network, and analyzes its shortcomings in practical applications. Secondly, combined with network fingerprinting and cyberspace search engine technology, a penetration testing framework for large-scale network based on network fingerprint is realized. Finally, a comparative test was designed and implemented, and the advantages and disadvantages of the penetration testing framework for large-scale network based on network fingerprint were summarized based on the test results.

articleTitle: Automatic Defect Segmentation for Plain Woven Fabric Images
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: An automatic defect segmentation method is investigated for plain woven fabric images. The original RGB images are converted into grayscale images by weighted averaging. In order to distinguish the defects from background, the converted images are enhanced using gray level adjustment and further filtered by ideal lowpass filter. Based on comparison, Roberts operator is chosen for edge detection and segmentation of the filtered images. Region of interest is finally segmented from the background which is verified by the experiments.

articleTitle: A Smart Book Management System Based on Blockchain Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Based on the application of blockchain technology, this paper proposes a smart library management system based on blockchain technology. The system eliminates the possibility of tampering with data by the unique workload proof mechanism and consensus mechanism in blockchain technology, and solves the problem of low efficiency and poor security of the central system by distributed accounting. At the same time, the danger of damage to the central database is dispersed, and data security is guaranteed.

articleTitle: Application Research of Machine Learning Method Based on Distributed Cluster in Information Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development and comprehensive popularization of information technology, in order to reduce resource consumption and environmental pollution, all walks of life have made efforts to promote the construction of information technology in response to the call of the state to achieve paperlessness. When more and more information data is accumulated at the PB level per second, usually we use a kind of information retrieval method to filter the files in the database that quickly and accurately search the data file which users care. This paper proposes a retrieval cluster structure based on distributed network design and performs unsupervised machine learning on the unstructured data content according to the classification learning model, so that the child nodes have the function of automatically identifying the semantics of the article, then the second inverted index is obtained by feedback learning results that it was based on the original index . The practical application results show that the design model is feasible, not only significantly improves the retrieval effect and the accuracy of data screening, but also provides strong support for subsequent big data analysis.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Programming Track-Before-Detect Algorithm Based on EKF for Acceleration Targets
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming at nonlinear issue of real system model to some extent in projects and poor performance as a result of constant transfer step size in conventional Dynamic Programming Track-Before-Detect (DP-TBD) algorithm when tracking acceleration targets, a DP-TBD algorithm based on extended Kalman filter (EKF-DPTBD) is proposed in this paper. The new algorithm makes use of EKF to estimate different transfer step sizes between consecutive states, avoiding mismatch between the transfer step size and target velocity when detecting acceleration maneuvering targets and thus the state searching efficiency for acceleration targets is improved. The proposed method can track targets with both strong and weak maneuverability accurately. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm and performance of this algorithm is analyzed and compared with conventional DP-TBD algorithm.

articleTitle: Directional Polarization Modulation for Secure Dual-Polarized Satellite Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a directional polarization modulation method to enhance the transmission security in dual-polarized satellite communications. Indeed, two components of the polarized signal are respectively transmitted by two orthogonally polarized beams, which are formed by a dual-polarized array. Subsequently, a deviation angle is designed, which is used to determine the difference between the desired direction and the direction of the polarized beams. With a positive deviation angle, two polarized beams point to different directions. In this manner, only in the desired direction that two beam gains equal to each other, the polarized signals can be demodulated accurately, while the constellation is distorted in undesired directions, which makes it difficult to recover the information and, thus the transmission security is enhanced. Theoretical analysis and simulation results demonstrate the security performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Railway's Turnout Fault Diagnosis Based on Power Curve Similarity
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of complex process, time-consuming and low accuracy of traditional turnout fault diagnosis methods, a turnout fault diagnosis method based on similarity degree of turnout power curve is proposed. Firstly, according to the matching degree with standard curve, the fault curve is divided into easy-to-find fault and difficult-to-find fault. Referring to microscopic idea, rough similarity is used to deal with easy-to-find fault and fine similarity is used to deal with difficult-to-find fault. At the same time, the rough similarity index based on Hausdorff distance and the fine similarity index based on dynamic time bending are designed respectively. The power curve of S700K turnout collected by Lanzhou West Railway Station is simulated to verify the feasibility of this method. The accuracy and time-consuming of this method are compared with those of traditional BP neural network and SVM methods, which proves the superiority of the curve similarity method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influencing Factors of Transmission Line Loss Based on GBDT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Based on GBDT algorithm, this paper establishes a mathematical model for analyzing abnormal line losses of transmission lines, and analyses the multi-dimensional factors such as power flow, climate, etc. It obtains the important indicators of the influence of each factor on line losses of transmission lines, and realizes the quantitative characterization of each factor.

articleTitle: New Media Big Data Analysis and Forecast Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In recent years, with the advent of the third wave of artificial intelligence, a large number of new technologies have been applied in social software and information services, such as big data collection and analysis, pattern recognition and user behavior prediction. The subsequent impact of mobile new media on a new generation of young people and the entire society has become one of the most promising and research issues. This paper obtains relevant data through online and offline surveys and authoritative organizations, uses Cronbach alpha coefficient to verify the validity of the survey results. The Spearman Rank correlation coefficient is calculated to analyze the relationship between the grade level of college students, the degree of influence on mobile new media and the duration of using mobile new media. Based on BP neural network and Elman neural network, the two models are combined by the optimal weighting method to predict the arrival rate of mobile new media information, and the conclusion based on quantitative analysis of mathematical model is given. The results show that the arrival rate of new media information on different platforms is on the rise in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Dimensionality Reduction of Hyperspectral Image under Close Range
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Hyperspectral imaging technology can make detailed division of data in both spatial and imaging bands. At the same time, due to the existence of noise factors, the data formed by imaging will have some redundancy. In order to explore the data redundancy and its impact on the subsequent analysis process, this paper analyzes the mechanism of data redundancy formation, including spatial correlation and inter-spectral correlation of hyperspectral images. At the same time, the process of data dimensionality reduction is discussed. In order to reduce the long-distance interference factors, the noise analysis of the forest image of close-range imaging was carried out during the experiment, and the model was used to reduce the dimension. The results show that the processed data dimension is greatly reduced, and the quality improvement is more obvious. Hyperspectral image dimensionality reduction can provide effective support for further computational analysis.

articleTitle: Road Anomaly Detection with Group Intelligence Perception
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: We consider a collection of the actual combat training of the troops that continues to deepen, and the use of training vehicles is becoming more frequent. We study the problem of detecting abnormal road surface, which may lead to traffic safety accidents and damage to the troops and officers and soldiers. In order to grasp the road situation in time, we design a road quality monitoring system based on group intelligence perception. The system adopts the concept of group intelligence perception, develops the data acquisition software under the smartphone Android environment, and places the mobile phone as the sensing terminal in the vehicle, collects the acceleration, speed, latitude and longitude data generated during the driving process of the vehicle, and collects the collected data. We establish the SVM support vector machine and processing application layer in detecting anomalies, further, we perform the experiments of system on the actual road environment, which can automatically detect the road anomaly.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Attitude Data Fusion Algorithm Based on Quaternion Gradient Descent
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: At present, attitude estimation and control are thecore issues of drones. Euler Angle method, direction cosine method and quaternion method are commonly used for attitude measurement. Because the first two algorithms have angles to solve singularities, the calculation amount is large, and the solution efficiency is low, which is not suitable for practical engineering. Quaternion attitude solving method can solve the whole attitude problem without singularities. However, the quaternion method has a problem of gyro sensor data drift. In the past, the extended Kalman filter (EKF) algorithm was used to fuse multi-sensor data, and the attitude quaternion was corrected. However, the algorithm is still inaccurate and computationally intensive. In this paper, a quaternion gradient descent (QGD) based pose estimation algorithm is proposed. The algorithm solves a set of quaternions by gyroscope data, and establishes an error function by measuring the acceleration and geomagnetic field strength data of the carrier by accelerometer and magnetometer respectively. The gradient descent method solves the error function to obtain a set of quaternions. For the two sets of quaternions solved above, the gradient algorithm is used to obtain a set of accurate quaternions, and solve three attitude angles. Finally, QGD algorithm and EKF algorithm are simulated for the data set, and the experimental results are compared. From the experimental results, it can be found that QGD algorithm avoids the linear error brought by EKF in using Taylor formula to carry out the linear expansion of nonlinear equation, greatly improves the accuracy of yaw Angle and reduces the calculation amount of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A Multi-Functional Smart Socket Design
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The concept of energy-saving sockets has been generated long ago, and has been developed so far, but the technology still needs to be improved. The design of this paper is based on this concept. We Design a smart socket with high power protection power off and low power energy saving. This design is based on the interaction between Arduino and ESP8266, and the measurement power is uploaded to the website. The website can monitor the power curve in real time and we can also control the electrical switch autonomously. This design is more versatile, safer and more energy efficient than existing smart sockets.

articleTitle: Research on "Cyberspace Security Testing and Evaluation" Technology Development Trend
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the development of network technology and the wide application of information system, people become more and more dependent on the network. The network information system attracts people's attention, and the problem of cyberspace security is increasingly prominent. To solve the problems of information leakage and network attack, we must first solve the problem of cyberspace security evaluation. We take the "Cyberspace security test & evaluation technology" for the theme, with a 1998-2018 (2019 data comparing only, not for analysis) in WoS (Web of Science) core data set (E - SCI) in 1666 high-quality paper as the data source, using Bibliometric, CiteSpace and VOSviewer analysis tools, and focus on the annual development trend, co-citation analysis and domain co-words of the field of cyberspace security testing and evaluation (hereafter referred to as the field). Our paper analyzes the early results, current hot spots and development trend of this field, in order to predict its future development direction and provide some guidance for related research.

articleTitle: Research on the Management Model of University Students Academic Early Warning Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The advancement of technology has greatly promoted education. And with the popularization of information technology construction in higher education institutions, the concept of "Big Data" has been paid more and more attention in the management of higher education. Data mining is used to analyze students learning situation. The design of the academic early warning management system can effectively prevent some students from being at risk of dropping out of school due to academic difficulties, improve the quality of higher education operations, and provide higher education managers with the idea of carrying out targeted risk prevention.

articleTitle: The Design of Disciplinary Book Recommendation System Based on Android: A View of Extra-Curricular Activities
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Other than classroom work, recommending learning resource in the extra-curricular activities is also an important factor to improve students' disciplinary study environment. And the learning resource, such as extra-curricular book, supporting video and other learning materials, recommending in extra-curricular activities requires the matching of the requirements of the student and the disciplinary of the resource. Taking the disciplinary book as an example, this paper firstly analyzes the problem of disciplinary-requirement mismatch between the student and the disciplinary book in extra-curricular activities, and describes the student's requirement for disciplinary book recommendation system. Based on requirement investigation, the specific demands for book recommendation system based on android are analyzed. Finally, the disciplinary book recommendation system based on android for disciplinary study in extra-curricular activities is designed.

articleTitle: Research on Audio Signal Denoising and Simulation Processing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This thesis mainly studies the denoising processing and simulation of audio signals, and comprehensively applies various basic knowledge of digital signal processing, and then performs spectrum analysis and filters on audio signals. This study uses the basic principles of digital signal science to realize the processing of audio signals, and comprehensively uses signal extraction, amplitude-frequency transform, fourier transform, filtering and other techniques to perform speech signal processing. For the study of speech signals, this thesis adopts the basic research method of designing FIR filter to achieve the purpose of denoising speech signals. Finally, the research conclusions are obtained by combining images and playback comparison of speech signals.

articleTitle: Reducing MMV-Based OMP Channel Estimation for Massive MIMO OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this paper, a new algorithm for sparse channel estimation in massive multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) systems is studied. The proposed algorithm reconstructs sparse channel using reciprocity of uplink and downlink channels and compressed sensing theory. Firstly, the basic model of multiple measurement vectors (MMV) for uplink sparse channel estimation in massive MIMO systems is analyzed. Then it is simplified as a single measurement vectors (SMV) model, which reduces the complexity of channel estimation and improves the accuracy of channel reconstruction. Finally, the proposed reducing MMV-based orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) algorithm is compared with the block optimized orthogonal matching pursuit (BOOMP) algorithm. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can significantly improve the channel estimation performance.

articleTitle: Friend Recommendation Mechanism for Social Media Based on Content Matching
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper introduces a friend recommendation mechanism for social media based on content similarity matching. It can extract information from user's homepage and then analyze the information to generate a group of keywords. Afterwards, it calculates the occurrence frequency of each keyword to form a ranking list. Finally it compares the lists from variety of users and recommends the user with the highest matching result. The paper is organized into five parts: introduction, business discussion, system functional description, methodology and conclusion.

articleTitle: Message Passing Algorithm with Dynamic Thresholds in SCMA
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Sparse Code Division Multiple Access (SCMA) is a new type of non-orthogonal multiple access technology that can support diverse services in fifth generation mobile communication (5G) systems. Message Passing Algorithm (MPA) can iteratively detect the multiplexed SCMA codewords. However, MPA has a slow convergence rate, and the complexity increases exponentially with the size of the codebook, which reduces the practical availability of SCMA. In order to reduce the decoding complexity of the MPA computation, a new method with setting dynamic thresholds based on signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) to reduce unnecessary computation is proposed in this paper. In the case of different SNR, different numbers of Superpose Constellation Points (SCPs) are selected to participate in the MPA computation. Simulation results show that the proposed Message Passing Algorithm with Dynamic Thresholds (DT-MPA) scheme provides similar bit error rate (BER) performance comparing to the current MPA schemes, as well as the complexity is reduced substantially. DT-MPA can flexibly balance the decoding performance and computational complexity.

articleTitle: An Overlapping Community Discovery Algorithm Based on Label Propagation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the defects of random update and poor stability of COPRA algorithm, this paper proposes an overlapping community discovery algorithm based on label propagation (COLBN). The algorithm calculates the value of the node by traversing each node, and finds the reference node to determine the number of divided communities. Then, the reference node is used to update the label for the adjacent node to identify the overlapping node, and the overlapping community can be divided when all overlapping nodes are found. This paper makes use of the network dataset of the bottlenose dolphins in the Magic Bay and the book dataset on American politics, and the comparison test of COPRA algorithm, which proves that the COLBN algorithm significantly reduces the update randomness of the label propagation process and improves the stability of the generated network communities.

articleTitle: The Research on User Short-Term Electricity Load Forecasting for Judging Electric Theft
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the continuous development of society and the increasing demand for electricity, the importance of anti-electric theft has become increasingly prominent. At present, the power grid is developing rapidly, the phenomenon of electric theft is frequent, but the quality of relevant inspectors and related technologies are inadequate in identifying electricity stealing. In view of the above problems, this paper proposes a new method for judging electric theft, which can predict the short-term electricity load forecasting of users. A short-term load curve prediction method based on multi-granularity information optimization template matching is proposed. The experimental results on the relevant data sets show that the proposed method has a good effect.

articleTitle: Time Delay Performance Analysis of Distributed Communication Platform Based on ZeroMQ
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to meet the performance requirements of ZeroMQ-based radar simulation platform for time delay, this paper performs performance measurement on time delay in the distributed communication development platform based on ZeroMQ. In the measurement process, this paper adopts the method of controlling variables, using a variety of tools and means to influence the delay performance of the communication platform - the size of the data sending, the communication mode, the programming language and the number of terminals. Testing and analyzing one by one to find out the main factors affecting the time delaying performance of the platform, so as to achieve the best performance of the platform.

articleTitle: Image Target Detection Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of poor foreground extraction in dynamic background images, an image foreground target detection method based on deep convolutional neural network is proposed. The VGG16-NET-based network model is used to extract the feature map. Using the deconvolution method and the pyramid pooling method ameliorates the defect that VGG16-Net can only classify the entire image, and the model can only receive fixed-size images.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Three-Dimensional Virtual Tour Guide Training System Based on Unity3D
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Traditional tour guide training has problems such as lack of internship resources, insufficient time and funds, and safety. How to scientifically and effectively improve the professional quality of tour guides and obtain greater economic and social benefits for tourism has become an urgent problem to be solved. In order to effectively solve the above problems, this paper designed and developed a virtual tour guide training system by using Unity3D interactive development engine and 3ds Max 3d modeling technology. It has the characteristics of autonomy, sense of immersion, interactivity and so on. It provides the trainers with a high simulation scenario and a good training environment of interactivity, which can improve the training quality.

articleTitle: Design of Centralized Control Architecture for Distribution Network Communication Network Based on SDN
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The rapid development of power Internet of Things has promoted the vigorous development of new services in distribution networks, but at the same time it has proposed higher differentiated performance requirements for communication networks. Software-defined network SDN technology is the current popular communication technology, which can separate the control and forwarding functions of the network. The former is attributed to the control layer, and the latter is still implemented by the underlying layer, thus achieving differentiated isolation of different types of services. However, the application of SDN technology in power communication network needs to be improved. Therefore, this paper designs the centralized control architecture of SDN-based distribution network communication network. The architecture adopts controller cluster technology, based on northbound and southbound interface schemes, and virtual power plants. As an example, the SDN-based communication resource management and control scheme is analyzed. In order to achieve reasonable allocation of network resources, centralized management and control, to solve the problem of access to business diversified communication methods to provide reliable support.

articleTitle: Research on Spare Parts Requirement Quantity Forecasting for Communication Equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Based on failure equipment board service process of communication equipment, spare parts requirement forecast models a closed finite waiting time queuing network has been successfully built up. Through statistical analysis of equipment failure data, change of failure ratio along with time was simulated using Bathtub curve and the method of least squares method. Then, the relation of equipment board gross and service parts requirement for a period of 15 years' operation life was analyzed for important equipment board of 0.54% and 2.21% mean annual failure ratio. Influence of the mean time to repair, equipment failure rate and reliability constraint condition on spare parts requirement was analyzed. In the paper, the queuing network and calculating model can provide theoretical basis for spare parts layout of communication equipment, etc.

articleTitle: Ultrasound Image Denoising Based on Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the improvement of medical conditions, doctors can diagnose patients with ultrasound images, but the ultrasound images currently formed always have a certain proportion of speckle noise, which will interfere with the doctor's diagnosis. Therefore, the research on the removal of noise has certain significance. In this paper, we propose an image denoising model based on fuzzy logic. Firstly, the model assigns weights to the image by means of the fuzzy membership function, obtains the required weight table, and then traverses the entire image. The role of the image is pre-smoothed, then a 5x5 convolution template is defined according to Grunwald-Letnikov (G-L), and the resulting smooth image is finally convolved with the template to obtain the final denoised image. By comparing the evaluation index with the current mainstream algorithm model, the validity of the model is objectively reflected.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of a Computer Security Control Circuit for Local Area Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: A local area network (LAN) computer security control circuit is designed for the practical problem of LAN computer users "one machine crosses two networks" on this paper, which provides a protection barrier for the information security of LAN computers on the hardware. This paper briefly analyzes the risks and challenges faced by LAN security. The overall design idea, circuit design and working principle of LAN computer security control circuit are described in detail. The characteristics of the system are summarized. Finally, the design circuit is verified by practical application in the unit. The application results show that the circuit is stable in operation, simple in operation, safe and reliable, and convenient in installation and maintain, etc., which has achieved the design effect and played a good role in ensuring the security of the network information of the local area network.

articleTitle: Link Level Comparative Study between OFDM and FBMC
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Fifth generation (5G) network is the new version of mobile communication which is expected to be commercialized around 2020. The requirement of higher data rate, lower latency and larger user capacity, compared to current fourth generation (4G) LTE networks, force 5G to adopt better modulation technologies. Recently, filter-bank multicarrier with offset quadrature amplitude modulation (FBMC-OQAM) is reported and orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) could be replaced by FBMC since FBMC has higher spectral efficiency and lower out-of-band emission. In this paper, the comparison between OFDM and FBMC in bit error rate (BER), error vector magnitude (EVM), peak to average power ratio (PAPR), and power spectral density (PSD) is obtained. The simulation results reveal FBMC has nearly the same performance in BER, EVM and PAPR as OFDM but has better performance in PSD. However, since FBMC needs OQAM, the computational complexity of FBMC is higher than OFDM.

articleTitle: A Navigation Spoofing Algorithm Based on Clock Error Fitting
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: As an all-weather and high-precision Positioning Navigation (PNT) System, Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) has a profound impact on people's daily life. Although the spread spectrum communication and other anti-terference methods are adopted, the navigation signal is still vulnerable to interference or tampering because the power of navigation signal is only -160 dBW on the ground. At present, the spoofer can be divided into two types: self-consistent spoofer and meaconing spoofer. Self-consistent spoofer has the advantages of setting flexibly for civil public signals and no transceiver interference, which has attracted widely attention. We propose a spoofing algorithm which is different from the traditional method based on delay filter. This method can obtain continuous error positioning results and lower the positioning (or timing) performance of navigation receiver. It is an effective way of navigation spoofing.

articleTitle: Systematic Polar Codes Based on 3x3 Kernel Matrix
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this paper, the construction of polar codes based on multidimensional kernel matrix is analyzed. In order to analyze the performance of the codes efficiently, the performance of systematic polar codes (SPCs) and non-systematic polar codes (NSPCs) constructed by 3×3 kernel matrix is analyzed. Simulation results show that SPCs have advantage over NSPCs in bit error rate (BER) performance while they have the same frame error rate (FER). So we may conclude that SPCs based on 3×3 kernel matrix have better performance than NSPCs.

articleTitle: Defect Detection Based on Edge Detection and Connected Region Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the production process of the print heads, due to the performance of the device and other external factors, some dead pixels affecting the quality of the print heads are formed on the surfaces of them. With the development of image processing technology, it is a good choice to use the related method of image processing to detect dead pixels. Aiming at the problem of accurately detecting the dead pixels of the print head, this paper proposes an identification method using the edge detection algorithm and the connected region filtering algorithm based on linear fitting. Firstly, this paper uses the Retinex algorithm to enhance the original image, and then, minimum filtering and wiener filtering are adopted in order to make further enhancement and remove noise. Secondly, edge detection algorithm is adopted to detect the textures of interference areas and dead pixels when identifying them. Additionally, this paper proposes the algorithm of screening connected regions based on linear fitting to eliminate all interference areas. Finally, the author reserves the dead pixels that need to be identified and then positions them. The experimental results show that this method can accurately detect the dead pixels in the line CCD scanned image and can be applied to at least five types of print head surface dead pixels.

Author Keywords: dead pixel detection of print head

articleTitle: Research on Computer Network Security Evaluation Method Based on Levenberg-Marquardt Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: As we all know, computer network security evaluation is an important link in the field of network security. Traditional computer network security evaluation methods use BP neural network combined with network security standards to train and simulate. However, because BP neural network is easy to fall into local minimum point in the training process, the evalu-ation results are often inaccurate. In this paper, the LM (Levenberg-Marquard) algorithm is used to optimize the BP neural network. The LM-BP algorithm is constructed and applied to the computer network security evaluation. The results show that compared with the traditional evaluation algorithm, the optimized neural network has the advantages of fast running speed and accurate evaluation results.

articleTitle: Music Detecting and Recording System Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To help people complete their music composing, and simplifying composing procedures and recording associate information quickly, a music detecting and recording system based on support vector machine (SVM) is proposed in this paper through the research about pattern recognition applied in music tune detection. The main processes of the music recording system is that the system will detect tune by Sound Sensor and change it into digital signals, then analysis and divide the signal into 7 parts by SVM algorithm and record it in files, it also show the pitch for each note on LCD display at the same time. At the end of tune, the result will be outputted as a simple numbered musical notation in file. Compared with the traditional music recognition system, the results show that SVM has good robustness to noise data, can effectively identify all kinds of music, and the recognition speed of music is better. In the practical application, our system can realize continuous data detection. In addition, it has strong anti-jamming performance.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Multi-Priority Hybrid Threshold Scheduling Algorithm for Edge Nodes of Satellite OBS Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper designs a scheduling algorithm for the edge nodes of satellite optical burst switches (OBS). Based on the combination of time and length hybrid thresholds, and priority control, it can meet the requirements of quality of service (QoS) in the current network. The hybrid threshold scheduling algorithm which is combined with multiple priorities is presented in this paper. And it can improve switching performance compared to a single threshold algorithm. This design is implemented on a Xilinx's xc7vx690tffg1927-2 FPGA, which is the main part of the satellite OBS edge node. The scheduler is realized with Verilog HDL, simulated with ModelSim SE 10.6d, and typical simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Chinese Tourism Review Based on Boosting and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is a hot topic in recent years' Natural Language Processing Research, traditional practices are through machine learning, current research is based on deep learning. Most models generally do not consider the characteristic of network data while in modeling procedure. Considering the tourism comments emotion distribution is not balanced, and adding distribution information of comments to the model will play an important role in the effect, this paper proposed a boosting based LSTM model that can well model the comment text. We have done the evaluation on the related data set, and the experimental results show that the model in this paper has achieved good results.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Electromagnetic OAM Waves with Circular Plate Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Recent research on electromagnetic wave showed that it could carry orbital angular momentum (OAM). OAM provides a new degree of freedom for electromagnetic waves, which can increase the number of transmission channels for electromagnetic waves and thus enhance the capacity of wireless communication system. However, the overall shape of the OAM electromagnetic wave is an inverted cone. It diverges outward and the center is concave with zero energy, so it has a high requirement for the size of the receiving antenna, and also has the problem of energy divergence in the transmission. In this paper, we built the mathematical model of OAM electromagnetic wave generated by plate antenna array and deduced the mathematical expression of this kind of OAM electromagnetic wave. Then we used simulation software to simulate the OAM electromagnetic wave and analyzed the influence of different model parameters on the energy divergence Angle of OAM electromagnetic wave.

articleTitle: A Real-to-Complex Conversion Phase Difference Estimation Method for Coriolis Mass Flowmeter Signal
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The estimation accuracy of phase difference of Coriolis mass flowmeter signal directly impacts the measurement accuracy. In order to improve the measurement accuracy of Coriolis mass flowmeter, a real-to-complex conversion phase difference estimation method is proposed. The precise phase difference is obtained by means of frequency estimation, initial phase estimation and an iterative interpolation procedure. The results of numerical testing indicate that the proposed method can suppress the influence of negative frequency component, and can improve overall estimation accuracy of phase difference. Especially, when the signal frequency is low, and the SNR is medium or high, the estimation advantage of the proposed method is more obvious. In addition, the experimental results indicate that the proposed method can improve the measurement accuracy of Coriolis mass flowmeter, which verified the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Sentiment Measurement Model for Online Reviews of Complex Products
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to analyze the polarity and intensity of the fine-grained emotion based on online reviews of complex products, and to verify the difference between the rating and the sentiment of reviews, a sentiment measurement model based on a domain ontology, named DO-SSM(Sentiment Score Measurement model based on the Domain Ontology, DO-SSM) is proposed. Firstly, build a fine-grained domain ontology based on features of the complex product, then leverage the fine-grained emotional intensity quantification method to obtain the emotional intensity taxonomy of online reviews. Empirical study indicates that the resulting emotional intensity taxonomy of the complex product online reviews of the model can achieve high accuracy and interpretability. The proposed model can provide decision support for users and enterprises, offering corrective information for online review sites.

articleTitle: Topology Design of VPN Based on Communication Performance and Server Load
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The topology of the VPN has a significant impact on the overall performance of the VPN service. How to construct the topology of the VPN system is a problem worth studying. This paper proposes a network topology generation scheme based on performance and load two factors to build a large VPN service. Because the load status of the server has a significant impact on VPN performance, we control the conditions of topology generation according to this conclusion, improve the minimum spanning tree algorithm in the graph theory algorithm, and add the load status as the control condition. We define evaluation values for three topological performance indicators to objectively evaluate the performance of the VPN system topology. Based on the evaluation values, we designed the topology generated by the relevant experimental investigations. The experimental results show that the performance-based and load-based topology generation algorithm improves the performance of the VPN service topology.

articleTitle: Face Detection Based on Template Matching and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Face detection technique is a branch of the Artificial Intelligence field. Most of the classic detection algorithms have better accuracy, but the speed is in general. The rise of Deep Learning has made neural network achieve remarkable speed in the field of detection, but there is imbalance between accuracy and speed. So in this paper, face detection based on template matching and neural network is proposed, which is committed to implementing the consequent that speed and accuracy are obtained the balance simultaneously. The experiment indicates that the algorithm is better than other traditional detection methods on speed and accuracy in the same time.

articleTitle: A Design of Wireless Sensor Network Applied to Acoustic Localization of Supersonic Bullet
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: For the acoustic localization of of supersonic bullet, the traditional method is based on single-point centralized microphone arrays. Although there are many localization algorithms for single-point centralized microphone arrays at present, the caliber of single-point centralized detection is limited, resulting in problems such as small detection range, poor fault-tolerant performance and low localization precision. Application of multi-point distributed system to replace the current single-point centralized architecture for acoustic localization of supersonic bullet, which effectively compensates the defects of traditional monitoring. Aiming at the characteristics and requirements of wireless sensor network for acoustic localization of supersonic bullets, this paper studies the aspects of system composition, wireless sensor monitoring node, wireless sensor monitoring network and data fusion method. With the features of distributed and data fusion of wireless sensor network, accurate localization of the shooter is achieved.

articleTitle: McCann's Retinex Enhancement Method Based on YUV for Space Station Image
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the space station, the hash and uneven illumination brings a significant challenge to the vision system, which is the precondition of monitoring, unattended operation and robot operation. This challenge is caused by the high dynamic range of light intensity and the light reflection of metal facilities. Aiming at this problem, Retinex algorithm was proposed to estimate the luminosity. Firstly, the structure and mechanism of human eyes are analyzed. Secondly, based on that, McCann's Retinex algorithm is used to enhanced the images. Finally, the original image is enhanced by merging the new brightness layer and the color layer. The experimental results show the validity of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: EM-Based Channel Estimation with Index Modulation for High Speed Train Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Index modulation is a novel modulation technique applicable for uplink wireless communication on high speed train (HST), while the channel estimation of Index modulation still remains to be settled. To estimate the wireless channel of the orthogonal frequency division multiplexing with index modulation (OFDM-IM) system, we propose an estimation scheme which adopts historical channel state information (CSI), basis expansion model (BEM) and expectation maximization (EM) algorithm to estimate the channel. The time varying channel is decomposed by frequency domain BEM into basis matrix and basis coefficients. Moreover, the basis matrix can be obtained through the data collected by the past trains while the basis coefficients can be acquired via exploiting EM algorithm. The simulation results indicate that the proposed scheme outperforms the data-aided estimators such as least square and linear minimum mean square error.

articleTitle: Exploring Computer Information Security Technology and Protection Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Social development has driven the rapid development of computer technology and networks and computers and networks have become "universal" from "rare". But the security instability that followed has also become a major problem in testing individuals and society. Therefore, in the fast and stable establishment of the computer system, how to improve the computer security defense capability has become a difficult problem that we urgently need to study and explore. This paper first analyzes the basic concepts of information security, refines related issues and puts forward suggestions on how to prevent and measure methods based on actual conditions, hoping to help the governance business.

articleTitle: Bayesian Network Based Reliability Prediction in Mobile Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In 5G and future 6G cellular network systems, the reliability and prediction of network service are crucial, because they are an important part of network automation. This paper proposes a service prediction model with throughput as a reliability indicator. We generate wireless network data by simulation and use Bayesian network method to learn and predict the reliability of the network. In the feature engineering, the load of the base station, the distance between the user and the base station, and the propagation parameters between the user and the base station all affect the signal to interference plus noise ratio (SINR) of the mobile user. Simulation experiments show that the prediction results are satisfactory in the case that low load at the base station, small distance between the user and base station and a small amount of shadowing in the propagation environment.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Data Acquisition System Based on Dynamic Threshold
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The static threshold methods for data preprocessing are mostly used in existing data acquisition systems. If the threshold is setting too large, important data may be missed, and setting too small, network transmission load may be increased. Aiming at the situation of poor adaptability of static threshold, a data acquisition system based on dynamic threshold algorithm is proposed. In the system, threshold is adjusted with autoregressive (AR) model. A good balance is achieved between bandwidth occupied by data transmission and the amount of data information with this approach. Experiment result shows that the prediction accuracy in this way is high and the mean absolute error(MAE) can reach 0.03. The data acquisition system has been applied for two years in situational awareness system of a equipment. During the two years, the situation that important data information was missed and network transmission load was increased excessively has not occurred.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of High Al Component AlGaN Films Grown by MOCVD
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: AlGaN material can cover the ultraviolet spectrum by changing the Al component. When AlGaN films are grown by MOCVD, the Al component in the film has an important influence on the electrical properties. In this paper, the AlGaN film grown in the electromagnetic heating MOCVD reaction chamber is modeled and simulated, the effects of temperature, pressure, and carrier gas composition on the growth rate of the film and the change of Al composition were investigated. The objective is to optimize the growth parameters by studying the growth rate of the film and the variation of the Al composition with these factors. It is found that increasing the temperature will lower the growth rate, but the Al content in the film increases. Increasing the pressure will reduce the growth rate of the film and the Al component content. Appropriately increasing the nitrogen content in the carrier gas can promote the gas phase reaction of TMAl and TMGa, and the effect on the chemical reaction path of Al-containing substances is more obvious.

articleTitle: A Study of the Application of Big Data to Tax Management
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The economic development of China has ushered in a new phase in recent years. Also, the rapid development of cloud computing facilitated the advent of the big data era. Nowadays, big data is widely applicable to all walks of life and has a profound impact on taxation management. Based on defining taxation big-data, the paper first analyzed the opportunities brought by big data to taxation management. For another, it analyzed the challenges to taxation management and put forward targeted measures for enhancing the application of big data to taxation management.

articleTitle: Research on Fresh Quality Detection of Citrus Based on Computer Vision and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this study, the Tribute Citru was taken as the research object. The color image of Tribute Citru was segmented under B component of color image collected by computer vision system, and the hue frequency sequence of Tribute Citru was extracted under H component of color image as the color feature of Tribute Citru epidermis. Then the structure of the neural network was constructed and optimized, and the mapper structure for nondestructive detection of Tribute Citru fresh quality was 141-8-1. The results showed that the accuracy of computer vision and neural network technology in detecting the taste parameters of fresh Tribute Citru was 86.67%.

articleTitle: The Long-Term Forecasting Method for IFTS
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To the insufficiency of the description for the fuzzy trend of uncertain data sets and the universe classification and to the problem of that the existing fuzzy time series forecasting theory is mostly limited to short-term realm, the model of long-term forecasting for intuitionistic fuzzy time series based on vector quantization, namely VQ-LIFTS is advanced. The classification of universe intervals is optimized with the intuitionistic fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm in the new model. Then the deterministic transition intuitionistic fuzzy rules are established by using back-tracking mechanism, and the non-matching historical patterns are solved efficiently by introducing sliding windows mechanism and vector technique. Therefore, the distribution characters of the uncertain time series data system are reflected accurately. The forecasting accuracy of long-term time series in the complex environment is also improved, thus greatly extending the fuzzy time series forecasting application. Finally, the experimental results validate the efficiency and preference of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Visualization and Analysis of Global Agricultural E-Commerce Research Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to gain an insight into the current research of agricultural e-commerce, this paper makes a visual analysis through the relevant literature collected in the Web of Science database. The published literature mining from different years, disciplines, countries(or regions), and the literature mainly contain basic research, applied research, research hotspots and frontiers. Knowledge graph, the method we use in this paper, provides an intuitive and convenient way for researchers to better understand the research status of agricultural e-commerce. Also, the results could strongly provide relevant reference for domestic studies in the same field.

articleTitle: Denoising Algorithm Combining Cone Beam CT Projection Data with Reconstructed Image
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to obtain high-quality cone-beam CT images and improve the accuracy of medical diagnosis, this paper proposes a denoising algorithm combining Cone Beam CT projection data and reconstructed images. Firstly, the noisy projection data are decomposed by wavelet transform, and the corresponding decomposition coefficients are obtained. Threshold processing of its high-frequency coefficients, the low-frequency part is subjected to Wiener filtering. The denoised coefficients are separately reconstructed by FDK to obtain four sets of 3D data. Then, the inverse wavelet transform and interpolation are performed to get the reconstructed 3D image. Finally, the reconstructed cone beam CT image is repaired by an anisotropic diffusion algorithm, which can suppress artifacts. The number of iterations during anisotropic diffusion is automatically selected based on the PSNR value of the image. The experimental results show that both PSNR and image quality are satisfactory, and the denoising algorithm in this paper saves about half of the time compared with the traditional CBCT denoising algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis of Traction Inverter Based on Compressed Sensing and Deep Wavelet Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the Difficulties in Fault Diagnosis of Novel Contactless Network Urban Rail Vehicle Traction Inverter, a Fault Identification Based on Compressed Sensing and Deep Wavelet Neural Network method is suggested. Firstly, the collected current signal is compressed and sampled by a Gaussian random matrix. Secondly, a deep wavelet network based on improved wavelet self-encoder is built, and the compressed signal is directly input into the network for automatic layer-by-layer feature extraction. Finally. The multi-layer features learned by the deep wavelet network train multiple deep support vector machines and integrate the recognition results. The method uses the deep wavelet network to automatically mine hidden fault information from the compressed signal, which has less prior knowledge and subjective influence, and avoids the complicated artificial feature extraction process. The experimental results demonstrate that the method achieves an average diagnostic accuracy of 99.15%, and can effectively identify 22 common faults of traction inverters. The recognition ability is higher than traditional artificial neural networks and support vector machines.

articleTitle: Study on Electromagnetic Scattering Characteristics of Inductively Coupled Plasma Stealth Radome
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: A quartz sandwich inductively coupled plasma (ICP) stealth radome model was designed. The finite element method and Z-transformed time-domain finite difference (ZTFDTD) co-simulation method were used to establish the fluid model of ICP discharge. Based on the spatial distribution of electron density associated with electromagnetic scattering, a Z-transformed time-domain finite difference method model was established to calculate the wide-band backscattering of the quartz sandwich plasma stealth radome. The results show that the inductively coupled plasma can produce a higher density plasma, which can effectively reduce the radar cross section (RCS). The plasma electron density peak increases with the increase of air pressure, but the uniformity will also change. difference. When the air pressure is constant, as the power increases, the reflectivity develops toward the high frequency and multi-band trend, and the overall attenuation effect increases. When the power is constant, the attenuation effect first increases and then decreases with the increase of the air pressure.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Efficiency of Communication Countermeasure UAV Interfere Ship-to-Air Communication Based on STK
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the ship-to-air data link communication model and the air-to-air interference model by UAV, a communication confrontation simulation research method based on STK is proposed. In the simulation scenario, by establishing ship-to-air data link communication model and air-to-air interference model, the interference efficiency of enemy ship-to-air communication is Simulation analyzed, and the range of communication interference suppression zone under three typical ship-space distances is given. This can provide basis for decision-making for communications countermeasure UAV commanders.

articleTitle: Research on Extract-Shift-Reverse Routing Algorithm in Inverse Butterfly Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: PEX, PEX-ROR, GRP and other special bit permutation instructions support fewer types of permutation, but they need complicated control information configuration and large hardware. In order to solve the problems, a new extract-shift-reverse permutation operation and routing information generation algorithm are proposed based on Inverse Butterfly network. The new algorithm not only can support the routing information for PEX and PEX-ROR, but also reduce the control information for GRP and the types of permutation has doubled. At the same time, The critical path of the algorithm is only adding one inverter, so the processing performance is basically the same as PEX-ROR.

articleTitle: Study on 4D Track Prediction and Optimization of Aircraft Climbing Phase
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To meet the ever-increasing air traffic flow demand for flight track prediction accuracy in Air Traffic Control, according to the standard flight profile and the real flight plan, the Total-Energy Model and related performance parameters in the BADA database were used to perform numerical simulations on the takeoff phase of the aircraft. We compared the predicted altitude, speed, and voyage results with the actual radar track data simultaneously acquired by regional Air Traffic Control systems in Shenyang, etc., and analyzed the sources of errors. And this would further dig the aircraft intention information and extract the empirical parameters to optimize the aircraft climb profile. The optimized model was used to simulate and predict real flights of different aircraft and different landing airports. The results show that the climbing profile optimization strategy is feasible and effective, and the optimized track prediction accuracy is obviously improved.

articleTitle: Summary of Research on the Application of Big Data in Auditing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Audit refers to the independent economic supervision activities conducted by special organs in accordance with the law to examine the major projects and financial revenues and expenditures of governments at all levels, financial institutions, enterprises and institutions pre and post the event. The traditional method of auditing makes the audit work time not free, and the audit work cannot be carried out flexibly, accurately and efficiently. The application of big data in audit solves the problems existing in the traditional audit method. Big data audit is the inevitable choice of the development from traditional audit to modern audit and the transformation from traditional data to electronic data. Under the support of big data technology, auditors can directly obtain data information and analyze and verify it with only one computer and corresponding authority, thus enhancing audit flexibility and improving efficiency.

articleTitle: Topology Control of Wireless Sensor Networks Based on Improved K-Means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) normally compose nodes with limited energy. LEACH algorithm is sufficient to increase the lifetime of network, however, WSNs that composed with large distance between nodes are not able to perform as excellent as expected.
