In this paper, a new algorithm trying to prolong the lifetime of WSNs and deal with the large distance problem between nodes is proposed. In the new algorithm, the intermediate nodes are inserted between ordinary node and cluster head to get the optimal path from node to cluster head, and find the most suitable cluster head in class. Simulation results prove that, with this new algorithm, the lifetime of WSNs has been prolonged and at the same time the energy consumption of WSNs has been reduced.

articleTitle: Access Class Barring Parameter Adaptation Based on Load Estimation Model for mMTC in LTE-A
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Considering maturity and deployment status of LTE network, it's a trend for Machine Type Communication (MTC) device to access to LTE networks. However, serious collision may be caused by massive access requests. In a Human to Human (H2H) and Machine to Machine (M2M) coexistence scenario, to optimize the access success probability, it is significant to adjust the Access Class Barring (ACB) parameter dynamically. In this paper, we propose a dynamic ACB mechanism in which a real-time load estimation model is used to tune ACB parameter. We evaluate the access success probability and average access delay of M2M with different degrees of traffic condition and compare them with those of a static ACB with optimal parameters while the performance of H2H isn't affected. Specifically, the proposed scheme conforms with the LTE-A specification so that it can be included as a viable solution.

articleTitle: A Link Prediction Algorithm by Unsupervised Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that single link prediction index cannot be applied to all networks because of the diversity of network structure, this paper proposes a link prediction algorithm which can adapt to network structure. Considering the complementarity of traditional prediction indexes, we use different prediction indexes as multi-dimensional data of unknown links, and use clustering analysis to transform the link prediction into classification. By clustering classification results, we consider the nature of unknown links comprehensively. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can adapt to different network structures and has good prediction accuracy in each network on the basis of comprehensive consideration of various traditional prediction indicators.

articleTitle: The Application of Big Data in Cyberspace: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the widespread use of network devices, all kinds of isolated sensors can transmit data through the network, and then generate hundreds of billions of data, making big data technology widely applicated in cyberspace. This paper uses a third-party database to search the papers on the topic "the application of big data in cyberspace". Then, based on Citespace and other bibliometric tools, these papers searched is analyzed by co-words analysis and articles co-citation analysis. The analysis shows that big data technology is widely used in cyberspace, and the degree and depth of application are deepening year by year. Through the analysis of its time axis of the co-word, we can find that the frontier research areas of "cyberspace big data applications" are "edge computing", "energy management" and "big data analysis".

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation and Analysis of Growth Rate of GaN Thin Films
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: By simulating the process of GaN thin film formation, several important parameters affecting the growth rate of the GaN thin film are analyzed numerically, and the relationship between those parameters and the growth rate of GaN is discussed. It is found that the average growth rate of the film increases first and then decreases with the increase of the substrate temperature. It is also found that the growth rate reaches its maximum at a substrate temperature around 800<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sup>C-900<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sup>C, and its maximum value is also related to the flow of TMGa. The results show that the growth rate of the film increases with the increase of TMGa flow rate, and the growth rate is directly proportional to the hydrogen and nitrogen content in the carrier gases under the conditions of high temperatures, whereas it is the opposite under the conditions of lower temperature. In order to improve the uniformity of the film, the growth temperature should be lowered and the nitrogen content in the carrier gas should be increased. The lower rotation speed of the susceptor has little effect on the growth rate and uniformity. But with the increased rotation speed of the susceptor, the growth rate is increased, and the uniformity of the film thickness is improved. The results obtained can be used as a reference for parameter configuration in actual film growth.

articleTitle: Swing Error Phase Modulation Jamming Method of Airborne SAR
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: A new airborne synthetic aperture radar (SAR) jamming-swing error phase modulation jamming is presented. The method uses the swing error of the line-of-sight SAR during the motion of the airborne SAR and modulate the phase error caused by the swing error to the radar signal received by the jammer to generate the jamming signal and transmit the jamming signal to the radar receiver. The effectiveness of this jamming method against the common motion error compensation algorithm-phase gradient autofocus (PGA) algorithm is analyzed. The simulation experiment verifies the correctness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Solution Design for E-Commerce Platform of Fresh Agricultural Products Based on Mobile Geographic Information System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the existing problems of e-commerce of fresh agricultural products of China, and proposes a solution of e-commerce platform for fresh agricultural products based on mobile geographic information system. The solution includes logistics and supply chain design, e-commerce model design, transaction process design, and the logistics distribution model design of fresh agricultural products e-commerce platform.

articleTitle: The Slowly Rising Cadmium Content at Bottom
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Based on investigation data of Cd content in Jiaozhou Bay in May, August and October of 1991, this paper studied the variation and sedimentation of Cd content at surface and bottom. According to the definition and model of Dongfang Yang's content changing angle, the results showed that at surface layers, Dongfang Yang's content changing angle was -7.96° from May to August and 9.09° from August to October, and at bottom, it was 1.71° and 2.86° correspondingly. In temporal variation, Cd content discharged by human activities to ocean slowly decreased to low value from May to August and slowly increased to high value from August to October. Further, through waters, bottom sediment amount increased slowly and less from May to August and from August to October. In spatial variation, whether Cd content transported by ships and wharfs increased or decreased, Cd content at bottom slowly increased all the time. It showed that from May to October, Cd content at surface rapidly and constantly sedimented to seafloor, causing the accumulation at bottom and slowly rising Cd content at bottom. Thus, with human's emphasis on the safe environment, Cd content transported by ships and wharfs decreased, causing no pollution to water quality.

Author Keywords: the model of content changing angle

articleTitle: Research and Software Implementation of Array Performance Analysis Method for Multichannel Receiving System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: For towed-line array sonar, the consistency of array receiving system is very important for the effective reception of acoustic signals and the full play of sonar performance. This design focuses on the consistency of the signals in each channel of the receiving system, and finally forms a performance analysis demonstration software, which provides a basis for improving the performance of the towed line array receiving system. The software is implemented on the platform of VC++ 6.0. The beamforming results and azimuth histogram of the received signal, the power of each channel, the spectrum of a channel, the Lofar diagram, the time domain waveform and frequency estimation results of the channel, as well as the correspondence between the channel signal and another channel can be displayed on the interface. The results of laboratory simulation and field test show that the designed software achieves the expected functional requirements, runs normally in the test, and has remarkable algorithm performance. It can meet the engineering application requirements of the software, and it has a good reference significance for the design and development of similar software.

articleTitle: Counterfeit IC Detection Research Based on Wavelet Transform and SVM
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In view of the non-stationary characteristics of the electromagnetic (EM) side channel signal, this paper uses the EM probe and oscilloscope to collect the EM side channel signal of the chip, analyzes the signal by wavelet transform, extracts the wavelet coefficient as the signal feature, and uses the support vector machine to complete the classification of the four chip types. Experiments show that this method can identify the chip model quickly, stably and low-cost. The experiment achieved the expected results. The average correct rate reaches 91.625%.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Online Editorial System for Magazines
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: It is one of the focuses of the publishing house to speed up the publishing process and shorten the review cycle. In this context, this paper is aimed at the online editorial needs of the magazine, building an Eclipse-based platform, and using Java language and database construction to build a system development environment based on B/S and Android mobile application environment based on C/S, and following the process of author submission, editorial preliminary review, expert external review, editor-in-chief final review, review feedback and contribution recruitment. Therefore, it is designed to assist in the collection and review of magazines and to standardize the management of manuscripts.

articleTitle: A Micro Capacitance Measurement System with Ultra-High Accuracy and Fast Speed
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: It remains a challenge to measure the capacitance of miniaturized capacitive sensors, usually on the order of pF, with a high accuracy and a fast speed. In this work, a novel differential capacitance measurement method is proposed, aiming for capacitance measurements for capacitive sensing devices. The design includes 7 modules: a sine wave generator, a low pass filter, amplification circuit, peak detection circuit, a differential amplification circuit, an A/D acquisition module circuit and a Bluetooth module. The system generates an AC signal with a frequency of 200 kHz and a variable peak-to-peak value up to 4 V. Our system has achieved a high measurement precision with the error below 0.1%, a high sensitivity of 1 V/pF, fast readout speed up to 10 kHz and excellent capacitance resolution of 3 fF.

articleTitle: SSRF Vulnerability Attack and Prevention Based on PHP
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper firstly introduced the SSRF and the reason of its formation, and a simple demonstration with PHP codes was made. Then, four attack types of SSRF and their combination with other WEB vulnerabilities were introduced and analyzed. And then, the introduction of two kinds of SSRF preventive measures was made and the general defense flow chart was listed. Web security is an important field of Network Space Security, while SSRF is also one of the top 10 vulnerabilities in web security. So, its analysis is of practical significance.

articleTitle: A Calculation Method for Aerosol Mass Based on Counting Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The Conception of mass subset was advanced firstly. Then the measurement principle foundation of aerosol mass was given starting from the function of aerosol number mass distribution. Using sieve method as the example, the comparability between aerosol equivalent diameter and volume of aerosol mass subset was analysed. Based on this, the function relation between aerosol mass and aerosol equivalent diameter distribution was established, which can be extended to the other process of measuring equivalent diameters based on counting method. All these can provide the theory foundation for aerosol mass measurement model founded on the counting method.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Predistortion of Power Amplifier Based on Innovation Adaptive Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this paper, the adaptive digital predistorter (DPD) based on full Volterra (FV) series is studied for nonlinearity compensation of power amplifier (PA). In order to overcome the weakness of the traditional Kalman filter (TKF), we propose an adaptive Kalman filter (AKF) algorithm based on innovation which does not require prior knowledge of measurement noise. The innovation is introduced into the Kalman filter to correct the Kaman gain by calculating the maximum likelihood optimal estimating of the innovation variance. With this method, the proposed scheme can effectively suppress the measurement noise and reduce the adverse effect of noises on the accuracy of coefficients identification. The simulation results show that the proposed AKF algorithm can effectively track the change of actual noise, and the accuracy of coefficients identification in noise environment is improved by about 20%-50% than that of TKF. Furthermore, the proposed AKF has a better performance in terms of power spectral density and bit error rate (BER) than TKF, which demonstrates the prospective and validity in nonlinearity compensation for PA.

articleTitle: Development Effect Evaluation and Injection-Production System Adjustment of Water Flooding Reservoir
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Through the analysis of the basic geological characteristics and production performance of the reservoir, we have a general understanding of the reservoir situation, and then evaluate its development effect from many aspects. Under each single index evaluation system, we use the method of grey fuzzy mathematics to evaluate the reservoir comprehensively and study the development effect of the reservoir at the present stage. And in view of the unreasonable development and the poor development effect of wells and regions, the injection-production system is adjusted.

articleTitle: Understanding and Improving the Intermediate Features of FCN in Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In full convolution networks, the intensive prediction results generated by intermediate features have a disadvantage of low contribution rate. This paper used the visualization tools and quantitative analysis, and proposed a new training strategy using dynamic weighting strategy which was verified by experiments. The results show that the strategy can effectively improve the accuracy of prediction intermediate features results.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of Noise-Containing Acoustic Emission Signals in Tensile of HRB400 Welded Specimens
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Acoustic emission(AE) dynamic monitoring of HRB400 welding specimens during tension process will collect a large number of mixed noise data, increasing the storage space and transmission time of data. And the sparsity of the signal changes with the change of ambient noise, which affects the reconstruction performance of the orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) algorithm under fixed sparse degree. An adaptive threshold piecewise weak orthogonal matching pursuit (SWOMP) algorithm is proposed to reconstruct the signal, which is solved the problem of data quantity and guarantees the quality of real-time monitoring and reconstruction. The simulation results show that the reconstruction error of SWOMP and OMP algorithm decreases with the increase of measurement value, and the reconstruction performance of SWOMP algorithm is obviously better than that of OMP algorithm. The reconstructed quality of OMP algorithm fluctuates greatly when reconstructing multi-segment signals, while the reconstructed error of SWOMP algorithm is stable at about 0.05, which can reconstruct signals effectively and has high adaptability.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Reservoir Dynamic Analysis System Based on Web
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Reservoir development involves a wide variety of information and a huge amount of information. In the process of reservoir development, a large amount of information including various geological maps, development maps and surface engineering maps has been accumulated. It is becoming more and more important to use computer application software and modern equipment to comprehensively manage and apply these graphics and image information. After years of research and development, reservoir engineering dynamic analysis software has initially formed a software product, which has great prospects for promotion. This paper focuses on the reservoir network information system and the efficient management of oilfields, implements project management, and adopts project form.

articleTitle: Efficient Shellcode Detection Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: An important method to detect intrusion is to identify attack codes such as shellcode. However, the popular simulation methods seriously slow down the efficiency, while static detection can't guarantee the accuracy of detection. In this paper, we propose an approach based on the combination of static analysis and convolutional neural network. Probes are first used to match key byte sequences to filter benign data and obtain shellcode candidates, then convolutional neural network uses the feature set extracted from the shellcode fragment to classify candidates. In addition, this paper propose several instruction abstraction features for static analysis. Experiment shows that the proposed method can detect multiple malicious code with high detection accuracy, such as plain shellcode and encrypted shellcode.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Lifetime Prediction of Semiconductor Lasers Using Radiation-Induced Model and Particle Filtering Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The main factor, which leads to semiconductor lasers degradation in space mission experiments, is the introduction of lattice defects in the detector material produced by radiation. Therefore, a new remaining useful life (RUL) prediction method considering radiation effect is presented. The prediction method is based on failure mechanisms and particle filters, which realizes the combination of a physical model and data-driven method. The particle filters can abundantly employ degradation data and avoid ignoring the failure mechanism. Accelerated degradation testing (ADT) is proposed for effectively assessing the proposed prediction method, in which the proton radiation is selected as the accelerated stress. The prediction results are compared with other methods to verify the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed prediction method.

articleTitle: A Novel Implementation Method for GRP Instruction
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of large resources of existing GRP instruction, this paper proposes a reverse parallel extract-shift operation, and studies the method of implementing GRP instruction function by combining its result with parallel decimation. Then we design a hardware architecture, which can support GRP, reverse parallel extract-shift, parallel extract-shift, parallel extraction and cyclic shift. The results of experiment show that our design in this paper is improved by 0~30% and the resource is reduced by 35.2%~43.7% compared with the existing design.

articleTitle: Study on the Improved IDW in the Maanshan Reach of the Yangtze River Modeling
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Compared with the traditional IDW algorithm, this paper makes further improvements. In this paper, circular window and angle weighting factor are introduced. Then this paper uses examples to verify and analyze the results. The improved inverse distance weighted gridding interpolation algorithm is better than the traditional single interpolation algorithm in effect, measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Discussion on Computer Information Security in Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the development of information technology, computers have been widely used, but the information that comes with it is also well received. This paper introduces the current state of the computer and analyzes the problem of computer network. In response to these problems of computer and computer networks, according to the purpose of the computer, we put forward appropriate preventive measures.

articleTitle: Research on Machine Learning Methods for Intelligent Decision Problems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy, objectivity and scientificity of decision-making, people propose to use machine learning to automatically learn data and extract complex patterns from it, so as to make objective and fair decisions. Machine learning provides a new way to effectively solve decision support problems in many fields by virtue of its powerful ability to automatically learn data and extract complex patterns from them to make intelligent decisions. This paper mainly studies the construction of a supervisory classification model with strong generalization ability to solve complex decision-making problems such as disease diagnosis and financial risk prediction. Supervised classification learning methods such as SVM and FKNN are mainly studied. Diagnostic decision support methods based on combination RS and SVM, combined LFDA and SVM are proposed.

articleTitle: The Assignment of Crowdsourcing Tasks with Verifiable Capability
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Crowdsourcing outsources work to a community of people voluntarily contribute their time to finish tasks which were done by employees. The advantages of crowdsourcing are low-cost production, the synchronization of resources, improved production efficiency and catering to customers' demand. Current crowdsourcing schemes face many challenges. One problem is that highlighting match the interest and keywords with workers but less consideration on capability. As a result, the efficiency and quality of crowdsourcing is sacrificed. Another challenge is how to protect the privacy of workers and task publishers. To tackle these challenges, a task assignment method based on attribute signature with verifiable capability is proposed in this paper, by which the task publisher can specify the requirements of workers' capability. Consequently, the specific task can only be gotten and decrypted by the competent worker. Meanwhile, by the attribute signature, cloud server only gets to know whether the worker meets the requirements rather than information related to workers' attributes, thus better protection of privacy.

articleTitle: The Dynamic Vertical Variation Rule of Dongfang Yang
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: According to horizontal and vertical matter content variation model proposed by this author, this paper, based on the investigation data of Cd in Jiaozhou Bay in May and August of 1991, calculated the horizontal loss amount, vertical disputed amount and vertical sediment amount of Cd content at surface and bottom, and determined the modeling chart of horizontal and vertical variation of Cd content. The calculation results showed that in May and August, the absolutely and relatively horizontal loss amount of Cd content at surface and bottom was 0.02-0.52μg/L and 25.00-89.65%, respectively. There was absolutely vertical disputed amount of 0.02-0.52μg/L and absolutely vertical sediment amount of 0.01-0.02μg/L in Cd content at surface and bottom, with relatively vertical disputed amount of 5.00-89.65% and relatively vertical sediment amount of 6.25-25.00%, respectively. In horizontal transport, as long as Cd content transports through waters, whether northern bay mouth or bay center, surface or bottom, it will cause a certain loss. The higher horizontal loss amount at surface, the higher it at bottom. In vertical transport, the high Cd content at surface can rapidly and constantly sedimented to seafloor. When the source to transport Cd content got far, Cd content at surface decreased to a great or small extent, the vertical disputed amount of Cd content at surface and bottom decreased correspondingly, and when it decreased to 0.00%, it transformed to vertical sediment amount of Cd content at surface and bottom. This paper proposed the dynamic vertical variation rule of Cd content, disclosed its beginning, process till the end, and determined its dynamic vertical variation process, including dynamic vertical equilibrium point.

articleTitle: Research on Data Center System Design of Server Virtual Machine Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The so-called informationization of education is to introduce advanced modern information technology in the traditional education, teaching and management. Compared with ordinary undergraduate colleges, colleges and universities start late and their information construction is also in a backward stage. Since the end of the last century, the Ministry of Education has proposed that China's higher education has developed rapidly in order to "develop vigorously in higher vocational education." The control system is rather lengthy and the system scale is large, resulting in a larger data. The training room will be set up in the colleges and universities to be responsible for the management and maintenance of data. The main functions include: maintaining the safe operation of the server, effectively ensuring data security, being able to respond to and respond to accidents in a timely and effective manner and flexibly managing and distributing effectively. Resources, etc. This paper aims to introduce mainstream cloud computing technology into the information management system of the training room to form a data center system with more efficient operation, more flexible data processing and lower cost.

articleTitle: An Efficient Verification Way for the Encrypted EMRs Based on Sub_MB Tree
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the verification efficiency of the Encrypted EMRs, an approach based on Sub_MB is proposed. Firstly, a Merkle B tree is constructed to store the verification information, and the root and the internal nodes are signed. Then the clients could verify the correctness and completeness of data through computing the least verification Sub_MB. Our approach could reduce the cost needed in the process of verification; experiments show that our approach improves 10%-20% in contrast with previous work such as MB, EMB, and so on.

articleTitle: A Method of Remote Sensing Water Bathymetry Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Water depth retrieval by means of remote sensing plays an important role in safeguarding national territorial integrity and marine economic construction, as it has an advantage over traditional methods of bathymetry especially in danger and disputed areas. Currently, bathymetry survey in disputed areas is still not common. On the basis of seniors' research, this paper focuses on Scarborough Island of South China Sea and sets up model of water bathymetry based on Support Vector Machine(SVM). The effectiveness and accuracy mentioned by experimental verification provide reference for the water depth retrieval in danger and disputed areas.

articleTitle: Simple Transversal Signal-Interference Dual-/Tri-/Quad-Band Filters Using Single Rectangular Loop Resonator
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Compact dual-band, tri-band and qua-band microstrip bandpass filters (BPFs) using single open-stub loaded rectangular loop resonator and transversal signal-interference technique are presented. The even-/odd-mode number and mode distributions of filtering-circuit are determined by the characteristic impedances and fil-tering-layout size. The dual-band, tri-band and qua-band can be built correspondingly with different optimized parameter sets. Transmission zeros (TZs) are introduced to improve passband-selectivity. To verify the presented strategies, dual-band, tri-band and qua-band BPFs are designed and fabricated respectively, and good measured results are obtained.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Academic Communication Based on Co-Author Perspective - Take Library and Information Science as an Example
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In terms of academic communication, this paper explores whether there is an "academic circle" and the close academic communication through the module division of co-authors. The frequency distribution of academic communication is explored through the regression of the number and frequency of co-authorship between two authors. Through the statistics of the number of coauthors of each paper over time, the changes in the breadth of academic communication were explored. This paper selects the literature data of the journals of library and information science from 2010 to 2018 for experiments. The results show that in the past 10 years, the exchange center of scholars in library and information field has been significantly centralized, which meets zipf's law, the exchange frequency distribution meets rotka's law, and the academic exchange has increased in breadth.

articleTitle: A Corpus-Based Study of Metonymy of Container ICM
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Under the influence of behaviorism, Corpus Linguistics has been developed for nearly 50 years since 1960's. Modern corpus linguistics has been recognized by more and more people, and its application has become more and more extensive. From language analysis, language teaching, dictionary compilation to artificial intelligence, corpus has been applied. Corpus Linguistics has experienced the development of these decades, both in theory and in technology, have tended to mature. Applications in the field of language research are beginning to attract attention. The paper utilizes CCL(center for Linguistics) to study container metonymy to reveal the human's cognitive mechanism with empirical data.

articleTitle: Paradox Analysis Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the context of the rapid spread of the Internet, official media, new media, and self-media have spread widely across the Internet. People are increasingly keen to express opinions and public opinion through the Internet. Internet technology is gradually changing the formation and supervision mode of public opinion. This paper proposes a method of machine learning paradox analysis based on deep confidence neural network. This method can effectively extract the key features of online media communication content, analyze the public opinion position of hot events, and help to formulate an effective public opinion guiding strategy to avoid "public opinion trial".

articleTitle: The Dynamic Vertical Variation of Cadmium Content Caused by Source and Transport Volume
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Based on investigation data of Cd in Jiaozhou Bay in May and August of 1991, according to horizontal and vertical variation of Cd content, the vertical distribution and sedimentation region was displayed by the difference in Cd content at surface and bottom in bay mouth. The results showed that Cd content in May reached 0.58μg/L from ships and wharfs in northern bay mouth, and 0.40μg/L in August from atmospheric sedimentation in bay center. In spatial variation, with the increasing distance from source, spatial variation of Cd content was presented. In May, compared with bottom, Cd content at surface was higher in northern bay mouth and lower in bay center, which, whereas, was contrary in August. From the perspective of time, the source of Cd content changed along with time, displaying the variation of Cd content at surface and bottom. From May to August, the source varied from ships and wharfs to atmospheric sedimentation with a decreasing Cd content at surface. Thus, the variation in space and time proved the dynamic vertical variation rule of Cd content proposed by the author. In specific, with the farther source, Cd content at surface could rapidly and constantly sediment to seafloor, vertical disputed amount of Cd content at surface and bottom decreased, then varied to vertical sediment amount, which increased from the lowest value.

articleTitle: Impact Study of Temperature on Residual Layer Thickness in Thermal Nanoimprint Lithography
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Thermal nanoimprint Lithography (T-NIL) has the advantage of low cost, high resolution and high throughput. To further improve the replication fidelity and efficiency, residual layer thickness (RLT) must be optimized. The influence of imprint temperature on RLT in T-NIL was studied using a stamp with various protrusion densities by fast Fourier transform algorithm. It was found that the filling process started from the areas with lower protrusion density. RLT decreased when imprinting time and temperature increased. Higher imprint temperature can also improve RLT uniformity. There was a threshold temperature, above which RLT reduced sharply with the temperature increased. These findings are meaningful in understanding the filling mechanism and designing optimized stamp profiles and process parameters.

articleTitle: A Survey and Empirical Research on Online Animation Course Based on User Perspective
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: For the film & television animation major, E-learning makes a success compared to the traditional teaching mode, which has become an important auxiliary teaching tool in colleges and universities. However, E-learning still has an obvious shortcoming, namely the online course lacks direct supervision and guidance, which requires the student to master a high-level ability of self-control and understanding. With five years' experience of producing film & television and six years' experience of teaching animation in universities, the author conducts statistics and analyses on the advantages and disadvantages of traditional and online teaching modes trough the questionnaire. And then, based on the analyses, the author develops a more reasonable teaching mode and designs a three-years' course experiment to verify that the teaching mode developed by the author is effective.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Campus Energy Consumption Monitoring and Management System Based on IPv6
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: On the basis of system analysis, the article introduced the overall structure and implementation method of campus energy consumption monitoring and management system by detail, made interception of system images during actual monitoring operation, offered the main procedure code of some functions of the system data visualization module. Practice showed that the system could not only provide a reference for managers to fully grasp the status of campus energy consumption, but also provide convenience for users to inquire about energy usage.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Development of IoT Platform in Broadcasting and TV Industry
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper introduces the current development situation and typical market characteristics of the Internet of Things (IoT), then proposes the architecture system of the IoT platform as well as the corresponding business development strategies. Subsequently, in view of security problems faced by the IoT platform, several countermeasure proposals are put forward for Radio & TV network enterprises, aiming at providing some references for the development of the IoT in the broadcasting and TV industry.

articleTitle: Transmittance Calculation of Terahertz Wave in Fog Based on MC Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The basic physical characteristics of fog are analysed in this paper. According to Mie theory, the average extinction parameters of THz wave and infrared radiation of fog droplets at different frequencies are calculated. Based on the weighted MC method, the relationship between the transmittance of THz wave in advection fog and radiation fog, visibility and transmission distance is calculated and compared with the transmittance of infrared radiation. The results show that under the same conditions, the lower the frequency of THz wave is, the higher the transmittance is, and the transmittance of terahertz wave is much larger than that of infrared radiation. It has stronger ability to penetrate thick fog. When the visibility is the same, advection fog has larger droplets than radiation fog. The transmission of terahertz wave in radiation fog is obviously larger than that in advection fog. Advection fog has greater influence on the transmission of terahertz wave.

articleTitle: A Circular Sub-Wavelength Radial Polarization Grating Based on Nanotechnology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: A circular sub-wavelength radial polarization grating (RPG) is designed based on nanotechnology in this paper. It is capable of converting a Faraday rotation angle into synchronized rotation linearly, so it can be employed in an optical current transducer to achieve a linear and optical power independent measurement. The Jones matrix and the rigorous coupled wave theory are used to analyze and optimize the parameters of the grating. The simulations and experiments show that the grating has a TM transmission rate being greater than 80% and an extinction ratio being more than 100. Moreover, its temperature characteristics have been studied in detail, theoretically.

articleTitle: Power Minimization of Full Duplex Communication System Based on Interference Exploit
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the power saving resource allocation algorithm design for multiuser full-duplex (FD) multi-input multi-output (MIMO) wireless communication system. Different from the conventional approaches which regards the interference as a harmful factor to mitigate it, we propose to use the channel state information (CSI) of FD radio base station (BS) and the downlink data symbol knowledge to constructively exploit multiuser interference. We formulate a multi-objective optimization problem (MOOP) via modified weighted Tchebycheff method to study the joint minimization of two conflicting system design objectives, i.e., total downlink transmit power minimization and total uplink transmit power minimization, while guaranteeing the quality of service (QoS) of all users. In the proposed MOOP, in order to adapt to the constructive interference (CI) of general phase shift keying (PSK) modulation signals, we adjust the signal to interference plus noise ratio (SINR) constraints for downlink users. The simulation results show that compared with the existing algorithms, the proposed algorithm can achieve more power savings.

articleTitle: Structured Sparse Representation in Resting-State fMRI Image Processing for Mild Traumatic Brain Injury Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI) is difficult to diagnose by clinical imaging. Thus many mTBI patients are usually misdiagnosed and cause some long-term sequelae. According to our previous studies that there is nothing much changed structure of whole brain network in mTBI, we propose a framework based on Structured Sparse representation (SSR) to analyze the Functional Brain Connectivity (FBC) of mTBI from rs-fMRI. Our SSR strategy can extract the similarity of structure and the differences components from subjects divided into 32-patients group and 28-healthy control group. The experiment indicated that there were no significant difference on whole brain characteristics, clustering coefficient, and shortest path length (p > 0.05) between the mTBI and healthy groups. However, mTBI group demonstrated significantly different graph theoretic parameters including node connectivity, node-clustering coefficient, shortest path length, betweenness centrality, and local and global efficiency at several brain areas. Typically, the disorder of executive function was significantly correlated to the global efficiencies of the dorsolateral superior frontal gyrus and anterior cingulate cortex.

articleTitle: A New Location Detection Algorithm Research for the Boundary of Submarine Cable in Harbor Area
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the position detection of ship position in the submarine cable area, the ARPA radar target identification information is integrated into the shore-based ship automatic identification AIS system to provide more accurate, reliable and practical data for the ship navigation and collision avoidance system. The ship position information auxiliary radar Positioning the echo target position, summarizing the optimal track system framework, the joint detection algorithm of coordinate position point target for sea-belt boundary protection is proposed, and the grey prediction model theory is established. The ship track estimation and broadcast system detects and maps the target position of the submarine cable warning area in real time, avoids the trouble of manual secondary calculation and judgment, improves the accuracy of the target identification of the submarine cable area, and ensures the safety of the submarine cable area.

articleTitle: Adaptive High Maneuvers Flight Control with Input Constraint
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: A robust adaptive neural control scheme is proposed to resolve aircraft high maneuvers flight input saturation problem. RBF neural networks are utilized to approximate the unknown uncertain parts of aircraft model. The hyperbolic tangent function is used to handle the system input saturation problem. A new error is defined by saturated actual control input and desired control input, and a high maneuvers flight control law is designed by combining this error to eliminate the effect caused by saturated input. It is proved that all the signals in the closed-loop control system are bounded, and the attitude angle tracking error can converge to an arbitrarily small neighborhood around zero by choosing the appropriate design parameters.

articleTitle: Research on Kindergarten Science Field Teaching Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of information and communication technology, human society began to enter the era of big data. We can perceive and record more large-scale and diverse data through the analysis and processing of these data. We can deeply excavate the intrinsic information and core values contained therein through big data. Big data is becoming a powerful driving force to promote organizational innovation, industrial upgrading and economic development. It has strong application needs and broad application prospects in many fields of modern society. Among them, the field of education is considered as an important application area of big data. Firstly, this paper analyses the function mechanism of big data and kindergarten science field teaching. Then, this paper analyses the current situation of science teaching in rural kindergartens. Finally, some suggestions are put forward for kindergarten science teaching.

articleTitle: Application of Adaptive Fuzzy Integral Theory to Variable Structure Controllers
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: A new scheme is put forward, which combines fuzzy control, adaptive control and integral theory into the design of variable structure controllers. Fuzzy control and adaptive control are adopted to restrain the chattering around the sliding plane. Integral theory is introduced to eliminate static errors of the system. The results of simulation experiments indicate that the scheme is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: A Camera Node Wake-Up Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In wireless sensor networks, aiming at the problem that camera nodes consume more energy, a multi-node cooperative camera node wake-up algorithm based on image quality is proposed. A three-tier cooperative wireless sensor network structure model is adopted. Camera nodes are taken as a single layer. After common nodes monitor the event, the residual energy of camera nodes is taken as the main reference standard. Combined with the image quality, the multi-node fusion algorithm is used to determine the wake-up camera nodes. The simulation results show that, compared with the current wake-up algorithm of camera nodes, this algorithm prolongs the lifetime of camera nodes on the basis of guaranteeing image quality.

articleTitle: Code Rate Estimation and Code Sequence Retrieval of the Binary Phase-Coded Radar Signal Using Further Autocorrelation Analysing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The binary phase-coded radar signal code rate estimation and code sequence retrieval are important in EW and ELINT. In this paper, the statistical autocorrelation function of the binary phase-coded radar signal is studied in depth, and a code rate estimation and a code sequence retrieval method are proposed. With the signal symbol length rough estimation, the sampling points of calculating statistical autocorrelation function can be adaptively selected. Furthermore, exploring the valley points of the autocorrelation function envelope to detect the signal phase abrupt points, the signal code rate can be estimated and the code sequence can be recovered. Experimental results corroborate that the proposed method can effectively reduce the mean square errors of the code rate estimation and code sequence retrieval in low signal to noise ratio (SNR) conditions.

articleTitle: Research and Design of New Basic Geographic Information System Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The new basic geographic information system platform software is a high-tech technology that integrates computer graphics and databases to store and process space information. It organically combines geographical location and related attributes, and outputs accurately and realistically according to actual needs. To users, meet the requirements of urban construction, business management, the resident life to the space information request.

articleTitle: Discussion and Thinking about Financial System Construction of Modern Company
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Under the strong promotion of the market economy, the development of the modern company has been greatly promoted. In this situation, the strengthening of the financial management system is becoming more and more important, which has been one of the topics of common concern within the modern company. Strengthening the construction of financial management mechanism can promote the smooth development of the company's production and operation activities in order to continuously improve the level of financial management, maximize the financial management needs, and provide strong institutional guarantees.

articleTitle: A Study on Human-Capital-Intensive Firms: A Challenge to Traditional Issues
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The differences of character between Human-capital-intensive firms and Physical-capital-intensive firms put forward many new issues of firm theories which demands immediate solution and urges for rethinking of issues which have been in consensus under traditional theoretical framework. Basing on the heterogeneity of the human-capital-intensive firms, this paper re-evaluates four traditional problems, including the power in the firm, the competitiveness of the firm, and the value of the firm and the functions of the entrepreneurs.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Circuit Protection for Unmanned Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With increasing dependence on precision electronic equipment, self-protection is becoming essential. The protection circuits commonly used before were fuses and circuit breakers which, however, they are not enough for the current need of high-speed protection circuits and automated engineering logic. In this paper, we develop a new ultrahigh-speed protection circuit, which is over exceeded 20 times faster than traditional circuits and has the ability to self-recover when any failure occurs. With the new circuit developed, it is not necessary to do manual restart and will meet the future needs of protection for electronic precision equipment. This design provides greater convenience and reliability for the unmanned equipment for the future.

articleTitle: Study on the Accuracy of Chinese Teaching Goal Setting under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, the way information travels has changed a lot. As the promoter of the Internet era, the new generation of college students have been greatly influenced by the Internet in their study and life. College Chinese can not only promote the integration of disciplines, but also cultivate the humanistic quality, so that students can become the comprehensive talents. The college Chinese course reform should be good at using the Internet to assist teaching, and the teaching content should also reflect the sense of The Times. However, in the current college Chinese teaching, many colleges do not have accurate positioning of teaching objectives. There are many problems, such as traditional teaching methods, outdated teaching contents and outdated teaching ideas, which result in students' lack of interest in learning Chinese. The scientific and accurate determination of college Chinese teaching goal is related to the the overall quality of teaching. This paper first analysis the significance of precision teaching. Then, this paper makes a statistical analyyze on the problem of Chinese teaching goal. Based on the background of big data, we developed the target process and teaching hierarchy relationship of Chinese teaching. Finally, this paper constructs the framework of Chinese teaching target precision model.

articleTitle: Analysis of Receivers' Nonlinearity by the Use of Double-Frequency Diagram
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The automated double-frequency test technique is one of the most effective methods for detecting the nonlinear characteristics of radio receivers. By identifying the double-frequency diagram measured by the double-frequency test, all nonlinear response (including intermodulation, cross-modulation and spurious response, etc) types and orders can be obtained. The identification methods of double-frequency diagram by manual and automated process are developed, which simplifies the identification process and improves the recognition efficiency. The nonlinear characteristics of the receiver are analyzed by the identification of the response line in the double-frequency diagram.

articleTitle: Application of Metrology Geography in Regional Economics
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Metrology geography belongs to the methodology of geography. It obtains various relevant theoretical conclusions through the analysis of various factors in physical geography and human geography with the use of mathematics and computer technology. From the 1980s to the present, China has made many achievements in the study of metrological geography. In recent years, more and more scholars have begun to pay attention to the micro-level research of regional economy, such as the research of settlements from the perspective of land plots to study the relationship between environment and villages. This paper introduces the relevant content of metrological geography, the status quo of development and the specific application of metrological geography in the regional economy.

articleTitle: Round Paper Tray Grabbing Detection Based on Hough Transform Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: For various problems such as poor precision, too long calculation time and too large storage amount in the detection of the target circle, an improved Hough transform based on target circle detection method is proposed. The method first uses connected component labeling on the target image, and obtains roundness value by getting on roundness calculation. Then we set the threshold to estimate the approximate location of the connected component of the target circle, and get on double detection on the target with external influence by performing Hough transform and fitting circle operation. We calculate the difference between the radius and the center of the circle, and the results improve the computational efficiency and detection accuracy.

articleTitle: The Self-Organizing Mapping Based on Kernel Function
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Distance measurement function of SOM has great impact on learning process, it directly affects the matching degree between the winning neuron and the current input neuron. The Euclidean distance measurement usually taken makes learning process achieve success easily for date set with Euclidean hypersphere distribution. But for other distributions of date sets, the distance measurement may lead to bad results. Therefore, the distance measurement based on kernel function is applied in SOM (KSOM) in this paper. And three image data sets are chosen for investigating KSOM's effect: Lena, Boat, and Peppers. Experiment results show that the modified SOM has great results for date set with non-Euclidean hypersphere distribution.

articleTitle: PM2.5 Prediction Model Based on ABC-BP
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Now days, the concentration of PM2.5 is mostly predicted by BP-neural network. But the BP-neural network is sensitive to the initial value, and it is easy to fall into the local minimum value. Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm (ABC) is adopted in this paper for solving the problems and optimizing the BP-neural network, using the idea and method of that bees are looking for high-quality food efficiently, to find the best value of weights and thresholds of network. The optimized neural network not only possess generalized mapping ability of neural network, but also possess global iteration and local search ability like Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm. Through comparative experiments, it is proved that the PM2.5 prediction model based on the neural network optimized by Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm effectively improves the accuracy of PM2.5 prediction.

articleTitle: Joint Power and Codebook Assignment Using Cooperative Game and Coalitions for SCMA mMTC System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this paper, a fair scheme to allocate codebook, rate, and power for multiuser sparse code multiple access systems is proposed. The goal of the algorithm is to maximize the overall system rate as well as considering the user's fairness. The approach considers a new fairness criterion based on cooperative game and coalitions. First, a cooperative coalition algorithm is developed to negotiate codebook usage between two users. Then a multiuser codebook assignment algorithm is proposed based on optimal coalition pairs among users. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithms not only provide fair codebook assignment among users, but also have a comparable overall system rate with the scheme maximizing the total rate without considering fairness. Moreover, the iterative fast implementation of the proposed scheme has complexity for each iteration of o(k<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>), where k is the number of codebooks.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Partial-Parallel Regular Expression Matching Engine Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Start-of-the-art deep packet inspection (DPI) system uses deterministic finite automata (DFA) algorithms to perform regular expression matching. Nevertheless, the serial iterative matching process of DFA that read characters byte-by-byte severely affects the performance improvement of DPI. Although the multi-stride DFA algorithm can process multiple characters per time, the memory consumption problem makes it difficult to apply to FPGAs with scarce on-chip resources. In this paper, we propose a partial-parallel regular expression matching algorithm called P2DFA, and design a three-level memory system architecture based on this algorithm, which is implemented by Xilinx's virtex-7 XC7V690T chip. Experimental results show that, compared to the original DFA algorithm, P2DFA can bring about the maximum 60 times performance improvement while under the premise of parallel processing to 64 characters. In addition, in the view of memory compression, a method of mapping the memory address with the state transition table is designed, which achieves a compression ratio of 50% or more without affecting the matching performance of the entire system.

articleTitle: A Novel Tunable Predistortion Circuit
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this paper, a hybrid linearizer is designed for SSPA. By adjusting the bias voltage, different degrees of amplitude expansion and phase compression characteristics can be obtained. Compared with the traditional reflective analog predistortion circuit, this circuit can obtain better nonlinear characteristics. The simulation results show that the new circuit improves the amplitude expansion from 10dB to 13dB in 27GHz, and the phase compression is improved from 40° to 60°.

articleTitle: Research on RFID Information Security Technology Based on Elliptic Curve Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The security problem of RFID system is a great potential security hazard in its application. Due to the limitation of hardware conditions, traditional public key cryptography can not be directly used in security mechanism. Compared with the traditional RSA public key cryptography, the elliptic curve cryptography has the advantages of shorter key, faster processing speed and smaller storage space, which is very suitable for use in the RFID system.

articleTitle: Segmentation and Classification Method of Pulmonary Nodule Based on Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this paper, to realize automatic detection and classification of pulmonary nodules, U-Net neural network was used for nodular segmentation, and then the random forest algorithm was used to do the binary judgment judging whether the nodules were cancer. Based on the lung CT file and nodule annotation information in the mhd format of the LUNA2016 dataset, this paper extracted the ROI region of the lung through data preprocessing, and generated a mask based on the nodule position information, and then sent it into the U-Net model for nodule segmentation. According to the nodule information and classification files, the random forest algorithm was used to successfully classify and judge whether the nodules are cancerous.

articleTitle: Resultant Analysis Method for Supportability Evaluation of Radar Equipment Based on Drift Degree
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In view of the factors affecting the supportability of radar equipment are numerous and hierarchical, according to the requirements of supportability of radar equipment, the evaluation index system for supportability of radar equipment is constructed. In order to avoid the limitations of the single evaluation methods and improve the objectivity and accuracy of supportability evaluation of radar equipment, the concept of drift degree is introduced and the resultant analysis model for supportability evaluation of radar equipment based on drift degree is designed in this paper. The results for supportability evaluation of radar equipment based on cloud model method, the improved catastrophe progression method, the extension method and the grey method are analyzed to provide reference for the combination of evaluation results. The validity of the model is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Research on the Algorithm of Elliptical Interpolation for Equal-Step Length
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Elliptical interpolation algorithm is the key technology of numerical control machining of elliptical contour. This paper starts from the parameter equation of ellipse. It uses the idea that the chord length approximately equal to the arc length, and uses the basic principle of the interpolation algorithm which gradually approaches the elliptical interpolation point. The using of the elliptical parameter equation to ensure that the interpolation point is always located on the elliptical outline. Through the above methods, the equal-step length elliptical interpolation algorithm is obtained. The algorithm is simple to calculate. It need not to discuss quadrants. The interpolation accuracy is high, and it can ensure the stability of feed speed during processing.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy Logic Control Based on Targetlink Automatic Code
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: According to the implementation of fuzzy control algorithm in MCU, based on the existing sltank fuzzy control system in Matlab/Simulink, the 2-D lookup table model of fuzzy controller is established. The lookup table model conversion, MIL and code generation are carried out by dSPACE Targetlink automatic code generation tool. Generated code is downloaded to controller, the sdf file generated by the controlled object is downloaded to the Simulator for hardware-in-the-loop simulation test. The results show that the control effect of fuzzy logic algorithm in MCU is consistent with Matlab off-line simulation results, which effectively solves the problem of fuzzy controller implementation in MCU.

articleTitle: Application Status and Development Prospect of Big Data in Chinese Sports Field
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The era of big data has profoundly influenced the transformation of human society and culture. The application of big data technology expands the training methods and promotes the innovation of sports scientific research methods. Big data is the product of the science and the Internet rapid development. Statistics, mining and analysis of big data play an increasingly significant role in the field of sports. Big data has become an indispensable force in competitive sports. At the same time, big data has also brought great innovation to the whole sports industry. We need to keep abreast of the changes and seize the opportunities brought about by the times and policies. College physical education workers should strengthen the awareness of big data and devote their time and energy to the innovative mode of College Physical Education in the era of big data. Firstly, this paper analyses the application status and influence of big data in China's sports field. Then taking basketball as an example, this paper analyses the NBA Big Data Application Map and Statistical tables for software analysis. Finaly, we analyses the application of big data in sports field.

articleTitle: Interlace Type Recognition Analysis under Non-Cooperative Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In terms of non-cooperative communication, blind identification of signal interleaving type is an important part of channel coding identification. Based on the in-depth analysis of determinant and convolutional interleaving of linear block codes, a blind identification method based on sequence code weight is proposed. The method distinguishes the interleaving type by calculating the distribution probability of different code weights of the intercepted sequences. The simulation results show that the method can realize the interlace type identification quickly and has certain anti-error ability.

articleTitle: Network and Information Security Characters and Threats
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Focus on International novel Network research period that digital time arrives and became more prosperous after stretching of extra testing. Undergone a fantastical meditate according to the characteristics in related areas as openness and to encourage interchange and cooperation. Find out information security characters and threats' types. Analysis on the computer operation field and User Platform about Security Measurements, Security systems application with the implementation of vary antivirus Programs. Exhibition the world resource's prosperity during the digital social development.

articleTitle: A Four-Position Calibration Method of Inconsistent Angles between Units of TRUSINS
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Calibration is very important to improve accuracy and reliability of inertial navigation system (INS). Especially for a novel triple rotary unit strap down inertial navigation system (TRUSINS), the inconsistent angles between three units can bring a cross-coupling error related to the measured angular velocity and the specific force. Therefore, it is necessary to precisely calibrate and compensate the inconsistent angles in a rapid and efficient way. This paper proposed a four-position calibration method based on a single-axis turntable. Making use of double sets of measurements along all three axes of body frame, this paper established an error model for the inconsistent angles in this novel TRUSINS. A four-position calibration experiment was designed and carried out. The results showed that the calibration accuracy of inconsistent angles between units meets the navigation requirements of TRUSINS.

articleTitle: Application and Prospect of Regional Interlocking Based on Safety Ring Network in Alpine Region
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The regional computer interlocking system is a new interlocking system developed on the basis of the station computer interlocking. It uses communication technology and network technology to control the signal system of multiple station interlocks and inter-station occlusion. The railway signal safety communication technology provides a new communication field connection method for computer interlocking, and also provides a new application for regional interlocking. Using Ethernet as the network platform, the structure of security interlocking system is established, and the continuous wind tunnel signal monitoring and security interlocking control functions are realized by redundant interlocking functions of software and hardware. The related constraints are comprehensively analyzed, the optimization solution is put forward, and the safety and stability control system is designed. The ring network technology is used to improve the reliability of network transmission, and the hierarchical multi-cascade locking technology is used to make the data transmission more complete and effectively improve the efficiency of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Recommendation Method Based on Multi-Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Traditional recommendation methods mainly use the relational data of users and projects to extract characteristics of users, which is highly dependent on the relationship data and ignores the feature learning of the data of users and projects resulting in low recommendation accuracy. Moreover, the feature extraction of traditional recommendation algorithms principally rely to manual design causing the high time complexity of constructing feature model . In view of the above problems, this paper proposes a recommendation method based on multi-convolution neural network, which takes relational data as the basis of regression training. In addition to extracting the deep features of projects and users data, convolution neural network extracts the features of text data of projects or users, and constructs a recommendation model that can mine the deep features of users and projects. With Movielens movie data set as data source, this experiment is based on collaborative filtering, full-connected neural network, title text convolution neural network and the proposed recommendation method. The results show that MAE and RMSE have been optimized with multi-convolution neural network.

articleTitle: A Blind Image Information Hiding Algorithm in the HSI Color Space Based on BEMD and DWT
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: For sake of guaranteeing the equilibrium betwixt robustness and invisibility in image hiding, an image steganography algorithm based on two-dimensional empirical mode decomposition (BEMD) and wavelet transform is proposed in the HSI color space. In this algorithm, the initiate layer of intrinsic mode function is selected for hiding, and the local correlation of 8 neighborhood pixels is used to complete the embedding and blind extraction of secret information. The experimental outcome testify that the stego image has good robustness, visual quality and imperceptibility, and can resist certain noise and compression. In the previous method, the problem of requiring the original image to participate in the extraction is improved. And the algorithm finally achieves blind extraction.

articleTitle: A Feature Detection and Matching Algorithm Based on Harris Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Harris corner detection algorithm can detect stable image feature points in the image. But there are some problems such as large amount of computation, low positioning accuracy, only detecting corner positions without feature descriptor, which limit the application of the algorithm. In order to solve these problems, a new image feature extraction algorithm is proposed in this paper, which firstly screens the image twice, then the Harris corner detection algorithm is used to detect the corner position, and the corner position is optimized to sub-pixel level by iterative algorithm. Finally, the rotation invariant fast extraction (RIFD) descriptor is used to represent the feature point information. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm effectively overcomes the shortcomings of the Harris algorithm, it can quickly and accurately extract stable features in the image. It has great application prospects in many image matching systems.

articleTitle: A Dictionary-Based Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network Model for Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Natural Language Processing is an important direction in the field of computer science and artificial intelligence. It studies various theories and methods that can realize effective communication between human and computer in natural language. Sentiment analysis is a common and important task in natural language processing. It is often used to analyze and judge the sentiment types of text description. Movie reviews can provide valuable reference information for people to choose high quality movies. In order to effectively interpret movie reviews and understand the sentiment factors in movie reviews, the text proposes a deep learning method based on sentiment dictionary to realize the sentiment analysis of film reviews and to restore the real feelings of users as far as possible. The method first preprocesses the collected movie reviews data, uses the skip-gram model in the word2vec network to automatically generate word vectors, and transforms the sentiment vocabulary marked by Dalian University of Technology into word vectors. Then, the words vectors generated by text and dictionary are input into the convolutional neural network to learn sentence representation, extract local features. Finally, the Long Short-Term Memory network in recurrent neural network captures the semantic information and long-term dependencies between sentences, and inputs them into the logistic regression classifier to realize the sentiment analysis of movie reviews. The proposed method is compared with the Naive Bayesian and Support Vector Machine in the traditional machine learning method, the convolutional neural network and the recurrent neural network in the deep learning method. The experimental results show that the proposed model can extract more abundant features and achieve state-of-the-art classification effect than the baseline models.

articleTitle: Research on UAV's Autonomous Target Landing with Image and GPS under Complex Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
