abstract: Autonomous target landing of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is widely used in many fields. At present, most of the solutions have two main problems that need to be improved. First, the landing accuracy is low; second, the required sensors are complicated and high-cost. In this study, improvements are made to these problems respectively. For the former problem, an image processing algorithm based on Relative Total Variation (RTV) model is used to find landmarks. For the latter problem, a bi-objective optimization model is proposed to fuse GPS and image processing navigation results, and a landing algorithm is also proposed by using simple and low-cost sensors. A comprehensive autonomous target landing algorithm can be obtained by combining two improvements.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Enabled Security-Aware Applications in Home Internet of Thing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Data security and privacy protection in the Internet of Things (IoT) have attracted wide attention, especially in private scenarios, such as Home Internet of Things (HIoT). Data de-centralization and mature encryption technology based on blockchain technology provide a proper security guarantee for HIoT. However, common blockchain technology consensus algorithm consumes a lot of computing resources of devices, and it is easy to cause network congestion in LAN due to the size of each transaction and transactions' frequently spread. Just Blockchain Storage Model (JBSM) means every blockchain node in the network stores all of the transaction data that launched in the whole blockchain network, there is no doubt that JBSM consumes a lot of storage resources. In this paper, we propose a Blockchain and Centralized Storage Model (BCSM) for HIoT, which reduces the network bandwidth occupied by transaction data and increases the speed of transaction verification by reducing the size of transaction data. The model consists of three parts: HIoT, Blockchain Network and Cloud Storage Server. This paper analyses how BCSM improves transaction efficiency. Finally, through the simulation experiment on Tencent BaaS, the model is compared with the JBSM, which shows the method in this paper not only has the data security characteristic endowed by the blockchain but also improves the transaction efficiency to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Study on the Threshold Characteristics of Human Back Perception for Vibrational Tactile Expression
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this paper, the psychophysical method and the tactile vibration expression device are used to carry out the tactile perception threshold experiment on the human back, and the intensity threshold, vibration time threshold and vibration interval time threshold of the tactile perception on the human back are studied. The purpose of the experiment is to find the vibration intensity, duration and interval time with the most comfortable perception effect and the highest recognition rate. In order to design a concise, efficient and responsive tactile coding scheme, basic preparations are made. Through experiments, we obtain the important characteristics related to the tactile perception of vibration in the human back: (1) the absolute threshold of vibration intensity perception decreases with the increase of vibration time; (2) the differential threshold of vibration intensity perception between the back and waist of human body is below 0.15N; (3) the absolute threshold of vibration interval time of the human back is below 50ms. These experiments help to fully understand the tactile perception characteristics of the human body and are an important basis for the design of vibration tactile expression coding schemes.

articleTitle: Research on the Architecture of Advanced Intelligent Tourism System in a Hyper-Connected Era
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The development of 5G technology provides the basis to realize the ubiquitous high-speed interconnection between people and things as well as between machines and machines. In this so-called "hyper-connected era", new intelligent tourism system can be constructed in order to solve the pain points existing in the tourism industry. This paper reviews the development of intelligent tourism and analyses the pain points existing in the tourism industry. A new intelligent tourism system based on hyper-interconnection is put forward, which is centered on "tourist experience" and under the consideration of ecological protection, security and promoting regional economic development. An advanced architecture of the system is given.

articleTitle: The Framework of Software Defined Avionics Network for Multi-Platforms
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: For the situation that the current avionics network cannot meet the requirement of cooperative operations in aviation formation under complicated battlefield environment, the avionics network in Integrated Module Avionics (IMA) and the Software Defined Network (SDN) were briefly introduced. The limitation of legacy avionics network and the advantages of applying SDN to the designing of avionics network were analyzed from the perspective of the practical application of aviation formation cooperative operation. Then the framework of software defined avionics network for multi-platforms (SDANMP) was proposed and the forwarding plane and control plane in the framework were designed and described. In addition, the network controlling mechanism oriented to the value of information was explained and simulated. A reference for integrating the avionics networks into the network system of aviation formation cooperative combat is offered.

articleTitle: Analysis on Improvement Scheme of Distribution Network Communication Network Management
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: At present, under the trend of the smart grid evolving toward the power and the Internet of Things, the scale of the business of the power communication network has proliferated, resulting in an increasing burden on the communication network. In addition, the emerging power business has gradually widened the demand for communication. The traditional power communication management and control system lacks unified planning, and the network compatibility is poor, resulting in waste of communication resources and network delay. The quality of the network is not guaranteed, which restricts the intelligent development of the power grid. In view of the above problems, this paper proposes an improved scheme for applying SDN technology to the management and control of distribution network communication networks. It provides a unified management and control platform for flexible and open power services. The network architecture service, control and bearer separation are realized, the differentiated requirements of multiple services are met, the operation and maintenance management level is improved, the operation and maintenance cost is saved, and the reliable operation of the power service is supported.

articleTitle: Assessment of AGC Performance Based on Thermal Power Unit Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Automatic generation control (AGC) technology is an important technical to maintain balance between power generators and loads. As the proportion of new energy power generation increases, the grid has higher requirements for frequency stability, so an accurate AGC performance evaluation method is necessary. This paper establishes a model of thermal power unit, and the model considers the influence of primary frequency control. After the model established, the model parameters are calculated by the genetic algorithm. And the accuracy is obtained of the model by calculating the fit between the actual output and the model output. Then the AGC performance evaluation results are obtained through the established model. It can be seen from the industrial case that the proposed method can accurately calculate the AGC performance evaluation index.
